      width: 100%;
      max-width: 980px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98))
                  padding-box,
                  linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6), rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.2)) border-box;
      border-radius: 30px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      padding: 24px 22px 22px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 840px) {
      .app {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
    }

    header {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    header h1 {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    header h1 span.logo-dot {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: conic-gradient(from 180deg, #38bdf8, #f97316, #f97373, #38bdf8);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9);
    }

    header .meta {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-align: right;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    header .meta span.value {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Pet area */

    .pet-area {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18), transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.14), transparent 55%),
                  #020617;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 16px 16px 18px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .pet-orbit {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -40%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06), transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 75%, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.04), transparent 60%);
      opacity: 0.85;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
    }

    .pet-wrap {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-top: 6px;
    }

    .pet {
      width: min(260px, 60vw);
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #f9fafb, #e5e7eb 40%, #cbd5f5 80%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow:
        0 22px 45px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        inset 0 0 22px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22);
      transition:
        transform 200ms ease-out,
        box-shadow 200ms ease-out,
        background 220ms ease-out,
        border-radius 220ms ease-out,
        filter 220ms ease-out;
    }

    .pet::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 10%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 25% 15%, rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.85), transparent 55%);
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      opacity: 0.7;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .pet-face {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .pet-eyes {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 36px;
    }

    .eye {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #f9fafb, #020617 45%);
      box-shadow:
        0 4px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35),
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.9);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), filter var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .eye::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.94);
      top: 5px;
      left: 8px;
      filter: blur(0.3px);
    }

    .eye::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 51% 0 0 0;
      background: #020617;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out;
    }

    .pet-mouth {
      width: 78px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 0 0 70px 70px;
      border: 4px solid #020617;
      border-top: none;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, #fda4af, #fb7185 70%);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: inset 0 8px 10px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.6);
      transition: border-radius 180ms ease-out, height 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out;
    }

    .pet-mouth::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 55% 8px 4px 8px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, #fecaca, #b91c1c 85%);
      border-radius: 999px 999px 40% 40%;
      box-shadow:
        0 -4px 6px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.8),
        inset 0 4px 10px rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.9);
    }

    .pet-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto;
      bottom: -6%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: min(340px, 80vw);
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4), transparent 65%);
      filter: blur(12px);
      opacity: 0.7;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .pet-shadow {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 4%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: min(260px, 60vw);
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9), transparent 70%);
      opacity: 0.95;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .pet-bubble {
      position: absolute;
      top: 2%;
      right: 10%;
      min-width: 92px;
      max-width: 160px;
      padding: 6px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-4px) scale(0.96);
      pointer-events: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .pet-bubble::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -5px;
      right: 18px;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: inherit;
      border-radius: 0 0 9px 0;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
      border-right: inherit;
      border-bottom: inherit;
    }

    .pet-bubble.visible {
      animation: bubble-pop 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    @keyframes bubble-pop {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-4px) scale(0.9);
      }
      18% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1.02);
      }
      30% {
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
      }
      75% {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-8px) scale(0.96);
      }
    }

    .mood-label {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .mood-label span.dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9);
    }

    .mood-text {
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* Mood variations */

    .pet.mood-happy {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 25% 15%, #fefeff, #fef9c3 32%, #fde68a 74%);
      box-shadow:
        0 26px 52px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.4),
        0 24px 48px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .pet.mood-happy .pet-mouth {
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 0 0 90px 90px;
      transform: translateY(2px);
    }

    .pet.mood-happy .eye {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pet.mood-happy .eye::after {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .pet.mood-ok {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #f9fafb, #e5e7eb 40%, #c7d2fe 78%);
    }

    .pet.mood-ok .pet-mouth {
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 0 0 80px 80px;
    }

    .pet.mood-tired {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 18%, #e5e7eb, #cbd5f5 30%, #9ca3af 78%);
      filter: saturate(0.9);
    }

    .pet.mood-tired .pet-mouth {
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 0 0 38px 38px;
      transform: translateY(1px) scaleY(0.96);
    }

    .pet.mood-tired .eye::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pet.mood-bad {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 18%, #e5e7eb, #9ca3af 45%, #6b7280 80%);
      box-shadow:
        0 25px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8),
        inset 0 0 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
      filter: saturate(0.78);
      transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99);
    }

    .pet.mood-bad .pet-mouth {
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 70px 70px 40px 40px;
      transform: translateY(1px) scaleY(0.9);
    }

    .pet.mood-bad .eye::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .pet.mood-critical {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 22% 15%, #fee2e2, #fecaca 20%, #f87171 55%, #991b1b 95%);
      box-shadow:
        0 30px 60px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.65),
        0 22px 50px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98);
    }

    .pet.mood-critical .pet-mouth {
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 75px 75px 25px 25px;
      transform: translateY(2px) scaleY(0.87);
    }

    .pet.mood-critical .eye {
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.8));
    }

    .pet.mood-critical .eye::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      background: #0f172a;
    }

    /* Interactions */

    .pet.action-feed {
      animation: pet-feed 550ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1.2);
    }

    @keyframes pet-feed {
      0% { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1); }
      28% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.03); }
      60% { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }
      100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }

    .pet.action-play {
      animation: pet-play 550ms cubic-bezier(0.14, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2);
    }

    @keyframes pet-play {
      0% { transform: translateX(0) scale(1); }
      25% { transform: translateX(-6px) rotate(-2deg) scale(1.02); }
      50% { transform: translateX(6px) rotate(2deg) scale(1.02); }
      75% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-1deg); }
      100% { transform: translateX(0) rotate(0) scale(1); }
    }

    .pet.action-sleep {
      animation: pet-sleep 700ms ease-out;
    }

    @keyframes pet-sleep {
      0% { filter: brightness(1); }
      25% { filter: brightness(0.9); }
      50% { filter: brightness(0.86); }
      90% { filter: brightness(1); }
      100% { filter: brightness(1); }
    }

    .pet.action-clean {
      animation: pet-clean 550ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.85, 0.3, 1.16);
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 55px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5),
        0 24px 48px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    @keyframes pet-clean {
      0% { transform: scale(1); filter: saturate(0.9); }
      25% { transform: scale(1.02); filter: saturate(1.2); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.03); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); filter: saturate(1); }
    }

    .pet.action-pet {
      animation: pet-pet 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1.2);
    }

    @keyframes pet-pet {
      0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
      40% { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.03); }
      100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }

    /* Stats panel */

    .stats-panel {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8), #020617);
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 14px 16px 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .stats-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .stats-header h2 {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #9ca3af;
    }

    .stats-header button {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
      padding: 4px 9px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      color: #e5e7eb;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .stats-header button:hover {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 1);
      border-style: solid;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .stats-header button span.icon {
      width: 4px;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #f97373;
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.9);
    }

    .stats-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .stat-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr) 46px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 540px) {
      .stat-row {
        grid-template-columns: 80px minmax(0, 1fr) 40px;
      }
    }

    .stat-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .stat-label span.badge {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
    }

    .stat-label.critical span.badge {
      background: var(--danger);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.8);
    }

    .stat-label.good span.badge {
      background: var(--good);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.7);
    }

    .stat-bar {
      position: relative;
      height: 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 50%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
    }

    .stat-bar-fill {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 1px;
      width: 0%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22c55e, #eab308);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.8);
      transition: width 220ms ease-out, background 220ms ease-out, box-shadow 220ms ease-out;
    }

    .stat-bar-fill.mid {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #fb923c);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.7);
    }

    .stat-bar-fill.low {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97373, #ef4444);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.85);
    }

    .stat-value {
      text-align: right;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      color: #d1d5db;
    }

    .stat-value.critical {
      color: var(--danger);
    }

    .stat-value.good {
      color: var(--good);
    }

    /* Actions */

    .actions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 540px) {
      .actions {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
    }

    .action-btn {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 0, rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.85), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96));
      color: #e5e7eb;
      padding: 7px 8px 7px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      align-items: flex-start;
      box-shadow:
        0 9px 18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      transition:
        transform var(--transition-fast),
        box-shadow var(--transition-fast),
        border-color var(--transition-fast),
        background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .action-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow:
        0 12px 26px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.9);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 0, rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.96), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
    }

    .action-btn:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
      box-shadow:
        0 4px 10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.8);
    }

    .action-btn.disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: default;
      filter: grayscale(0.4);
      box-shadow:
        0 4px 10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    .action-main {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .action-main span.icon {
      font-size: 0.96rem;
    }

    .action-note {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    /* Status footer */

    .status-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      padding-top: 4px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .status-footer .left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .status-pip {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9);
      animation: pulse 1400ms ease-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.7; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.26); opacity: 1; }
    }

    .status-footer .right {
      text-align: right;
    }

    .status-footer .right span.value {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    /* Toast / warning */

    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      inset: auto 12px 12px auto;
      max-width: 260px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.97);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 35px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(8px);
      transition: opacity 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms ease-out;
      z-index: 40;
    }

    .toast.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .toast span.icon {
      width: 16px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #f97373;
    }

    .toast span.msg {
      color: #e5e7eb;
    }

    .toast span.meta {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
    }

  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app">
    <header>
      <h1>
        <span class="logo-dot"></span>
        BLIP • Virtual Pet
      </h1>
      <div class="meta">
        <span>Age: <span class="value" id="ageLabel">0m</span></span>
        <span>Last seen: <span class="value" id="lastSeenLabel">Just now</span></span>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Pet area -->
    <section class="pet-area" aria-label="Pet">
      <div class="pet-orbit" aria-hidden="true"></div>

      <div class="pet-wrap">
        <div class="mood-label">
          <span class="dot" id="moodDot"></span>
          <span id="moodTitle">Settled</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mood-text" id="moodText">Blip is curious about you.</div>

        <div class="pet" id="pet">
          <div class="pet-face">
            <div class="pet-eyes">
              <div class="eye"></div>
              <div class="eye"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="pet-mouth"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pet-bubble" id="petBubble">Hi!</div>
          <div class="pet-glow"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pet-shadow"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Stats / controls -->
    <section class="stats-panel" aria-label="Status & Controls">
      <div class="stats-header">
        <h2>Status</h2>
        <button type="button" id="resetBtn" title="Reset Blip">
          <span class="icon"></span> Reset
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="stats-list">
        <div class="stat-row">
          <div class="stat-label" id="labelFood"><span class="badge"></span>Food</div>
          <div class="stat-bar">
            <div class="stat-bar-fill" id="barFood"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="valueFood">--</div>
        </div>

        <div class="stat-row">
          <div class="stat-label" id="labelHappy"><span class="badge"></span>Joy</div>
          <div class="stat-bar">
            <div class="stat-bar-fill" id="barHappy"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="valueHappy">--</div>
        </div>

        <div class="stat-row">
          <div class="stat-label" id="labelEnergy"><span class="badge"></span>Energy</div>
          <div class="stat-bar">
            <div class="stat-bar-fill" id="barEnergy"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="valueEnergy">--</div>
        </div>

        <div class="stat-row">
          <div class="stat-label" id="labelClean"><span class="badge"></span>Clean</div>
          <div class="stat-bar">
            <div class="stat-bar-fill" id="barClean"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-value" id="valueClean">--</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="actions" aria-label="Actions">
        <button class="action-btn" id="feedBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">🍽️</span>
            <span>Feed</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">Boost food, small energy.</div>
        </button>

        <button class="action-btn" id="playBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">🎮</span>
            <span>Play</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">More joy, uses energy & food.</div>
        </button>

        <button class="action-btn" id="sleepBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">🌙</span>
            <span>Rest</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">Restore energy, light hunger.</div>
        </button>

        <button class="action-btn" id="cleanBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">🫧</span>
            <span>Clean</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">Wash & freshen up.</div>
        </button>

        <button class="action-btn" id="petBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">🤍</span>
            <span>Pet</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">Gentle affection boost.</div>
        </button>

        <button class="action-btn" id="surpriseBtn" type="button">
          <div class="action-main">
            <span class="icon">✨</span>
            <span>Surprise</span>
          </div>
          <div class="action-note">Random tiny change.</div>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="status-footer">
        <div class="left">
          <span class="status-pip"></span>
          <span id="statusText">Blip is booting up.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="right">
          Overall: <span class="value" id="overallValue">--</span>%
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <!-- Toast -->
  <div class="toast" id="toast" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="icon">⚠️</span>
    <div>
      <span class="msg" id="toastMessage">Warning</span>
      <span class="meta" id="toastMeta"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const STORAGE_KEY = "blipPetState_v1";

      const DECAY_PER_MIN = {
        food: 6,     // loses ~6 points per minute
        happy: 4,
        energy: 5,
        clean: 2
      };

      const MIN_STAT = 0;
      const MAX_STAT = 100;

      const petEl = document.getElementById("pet");
      const moodDotEl = document.getElementById("moodDot");
      const moodTitleEl = document.getElementById("moodTitle");
      const moodTextEl = document.getElementById("moodText");
      const petBubbleEl = document.getElementById("petBubble");
      const ageLabelEl = document.getElementById("ageLabel");
      const lastSeenLabelEl = document.getElementById("lastSeenLabel");
      const statusTextEl = document.getElementById("statusText");
      const overallValueEl = document.getElementById("overallValue");

      const barFoodEl = document.getElementById("barFood");
      const barHappyEl = document.getElementById("barHappy");
      const barEnergyEl = document.getElementById("barEnergy");
      const barCleanEl = document.getElementById("barClean");
      const valueFoodEl = document.getElementById("valueFood");
      const valueHappyEl = document.getElementById("valueHappy");
      const valueEnergyEl = document.getElementById("valueEnergy");
      const valueCleanEl = document.getElementById("valueClean");

      const labelFoodEl = document.getElementById("labelFood");
      const labelHappyEl = document.getElementById("labelHappy");
      const labelEnergyEl = document.getElementById("labelEnergy");
      const labelCleanEl = document.getElementById("labelClean");

      const feedBtn = document.getElementById("feedBtn");
      const playBtn = document.getElementById("playBtn");
      const sleepBtn = document.getElementById("sleepBtn");
      const cleanBtn = document.getElementById("cleanBtn");
      const petBtn = document.getElementById("petBtn");
      const surpriseBtn = document.getElementById("surpriseBtn");
      const resetBtn = document.getElementById("resetBtn");

      const toastEl = document.getElementById("toast");
      const toastMessageEl = document.getElementById("toastMessage");
      const toastMetaEl = document.getElementById("toastMeta");

      let toastTimeoutId = null;
      let tickIntervalId = null;

      let state = {
        food: 75,
        happy: 80,
        energy: 65,
        clean: 80,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastUpdated: Date.now()
      };

      function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
      }

      function loadState() {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          if (!raw) return;
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object") return;

          const fields = ["food", "happy", "energy", "clean", "createdAt", "lastUpdated"];
          for (const key of fields) {
            if (!(key in parsed)) return;
          }

          state = {
            food: clamp(+parsed.food || 0, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT),
            happy: clamp(+parsed.happy || 0, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT),
            energy: clamp(+parsed.energy || 0, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT),
            clean: clamp(+parsed.clean || 0, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT),
            createdAt: +parsed.createdAt || Date.now(),
            lastUpdated: +parsed.lastUpdated || Date.now()
          };
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Failed to load state, using defaults.", e);
        }
      }

      function saveState() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Failed to save state.", e);
        }
      }

      function applyTimeDecay() {
        const now = Date.now();
        const deltaMs = now - state.lastUpdated;
        if (deltaMs <= 0) {
          state.lastUpdated = now;
          return;
        }
        const minutes = deltaMs / 60000;

        state.food = clamp(state.food - DECAY_PER_MIN.food * minutes, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.happy = clamp(state.happy - DECAY_PER_MIN.happy * minutes, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.energy = clamp(state.energy - DECAY_PER_MIN.energy * minutes, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.clean = clamp(state.clean - DECAY_PER_MIN.clean * minutes, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);

        state.lastUpdated = now;
      }

      function formatAgo(ms) {
        if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
        const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
        if (s < 45) return "Just now";
        if (s < 90) return "1 min ago";
        const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
        if (m < 60) return m + " min ago";
        const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
        if (h < 24) return h + " hr" + (h > 1 ? "s" : "") + " ago";
        const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
        return d + " day" + (d > 1 ? "s" : "") + " ago";
      }

      function formatAge(ms) {
        if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
        const min = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
        if (min < 60) return min + "m";
        const h = Math.floor(min / 60);
        if (h < 24) return h + "h";
        const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
        return d + "d";
      }

      function getOverall() {
        return Math.round((state.food + state.happy + state.energy + state.clean) / 4);
      }

      function pickMood(overall) {
        if (overall >= 80) return "happy";
        if (overall >= 60) return "ok";
        if (overall >= 40) return "tired";
        if (overall >= 20) return "bad";
        return "critical";
      }

      function updateUI() {
        const food = Math.round(state.food);
        const happy = Math.round(state.happy);
        const energy = Math.round(state.energy);
        const clean = Math.round(state.clean);

        barFoodEl.style.width = food + "%";
        barHappyEl.style.width = happy + "%";
        barEnergyEl.style.width = energy + "%";
        barCleanEl.style.width = clean + "%";

        valueFoodEl.textContent = food;
        valueHappyEl.textContent = happy;
        valueEnergyEl.textContent = energy;
        valueCleanEl.textContent = clean;

        const bars = [
          {val: food, bar: barFoodEl, label: labelFoodEl, valueEl: valueFoodEl},
          {val: happy, bar: barHappyEl, label: labelHappyEl, valueEl: valueHappyEl},
          {val: energy, bar: barEnergyEl, label: labelEnergyEl, valueEl: valueEnergyEl},
          {val: clean, bar: barCleanEl, label: labelCleanEl, valueEl: valueCleanEl}
        ];

        bars.forEach(({val, bar, label, valueEl}) => {
          bar.classList.remove("mid", "low");
          label.classList.remove("critical", "good");
          valueEl.classList.remove("critical", "good");
          if (val >= 70) {
            label.classList.add("good");
            valueEl.classList.add("good");
          } else if (val <= 30) {
            bar.classList.add("low");
            label.classList.add("critical");
            valueEl.classList.add("critical");
          } else if (val <= 60) {
            bar.classList.add("mid");
          }
        });

        const overall = getOverall();
        overallValueEl.textContent = overall;

        const mood = pickMood(overall);
        petEl.classList.remove(
          "mood-happy",
          "mood-ok",
          "mood-tired",
          "mood-bad",
          "mood-critical"
        );
        petEl.classList.add("mood-" + mood);

        let title = "Settled";
        let text = "Blip is hanging out.";
        let dotColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
          .getPropertyValue("--accent").trim();
        switch (mood) {
          case "happy":
            title = "Radiant";
            text = "Blip is thrilled to be with you.";
            dotColor = "#22c55e";
            break;
          case "ok":
            title = "Content";
            text = "Blip feels pretty good.";
            dotColor = "#38bdf8";
            break;
          case "tired":
            title = "Tired";
            text = "Blip could use some care.";
            dotColor = "#eab308";
            break;
          case "bad":
            title = "Strained";
            text = "Blip is struggling; a little help goes a long way.";
            dotColor = "#f97316";
            break;
          case "critical":
            title = "Critical";
            text = "Blip really needs you right now.";
            dotColor = "#f97373";
            break;
        }
        moodTitleEl.textContent = title;
        moodTextEl.textContent = text;
        moodDotEl.style.backgroundColor = dotColor;
        moodDotEl.style.boxShadow = "0 0 10px " + dotColor;

        const now = Date.now();
        ageLabelEl.textContent = formatAge(now - state.createdAt);
        lastSeenLabelEl.textContent = formatAgo(now - state.lastUpdated);

        const lowStats = bars.filter(b => b.val <= 30);
        if (lowStats.length === 0) {
          statusTextEl.textContent = "Blip feels stable.";
        } else {
          const names = [];
          if (food <= 30) names.push("food");
          if (happy <= 30) names.push("joy");
          if (energy <= 30) names.push("energy");
          if (clean <= 30) names.push("cleanliness");
          statusTextEl.textContent = "Needs attention: " + names.join(", ") + ".";
        }
      }

      function showBubble(message) {
        petBubbleEl.textContent = message;
        petBubbleEl.classList.remove("visible");
        void petBubbleEl.offsetWidth;
        petBubbleEl.classList.add("visible");
      }

      function showToast(message, meta) {
        toastMessageEl.textContent = message;
        toastMetaEl.textContent = meta || "";
        toastEl.classList.add("visible");
        if (toastTimeoutId) clearTimeout(toastTimeoutId);
        toastTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
          toastEl.classList.remove("visible");
        }, 3500);
      }

      function animatePet(actionClass) {
        petEl.classList.remove(
          "action-feed",
          "action-play",
          "action-sleep",
          "action-clean",
          "action-pet"
        );
        void petEl.offsetWidth;
        if (actionClass) petEl.classList.add(actionClass);
      }

      function applyDelta(dFood, dHappy, dEnergy, dClean) {
        state.food = clamp(state.food + dFood, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.happy = clamp(state.happy + dHappy, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.energy = clamp(state.energy + dEnergy, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.clean = clamp(state.clean + dClean, MIN_STAT, MAX_STAT);
        state.lastUpdated = Date.now();
      }

      function handleFeed() {
        applyDelta(+26, +4, +4, -3);
        animatePet("action-feed");
        showBubble("Yum!");
        statusTextEl.textContent = "You fed Blip.";
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handlePlay() {
        if (state.energy <= 10 || state.food <= 10) {
          showToast("Blip is too drained to play.", "Try feeding or resting first.");
          return;
        }
        applyDelta(-10, +20, -16, -2);
        animatePet("action-play");
        showBubble("Wheee!");
        statusTextEl.textContent = "You played with Blip.";
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handleSleep() {
        applyDelta(-6, +2, +28, 0);
        animatePet("action-sleep");
        showBubble("Zzz...");
        statusTextEl.textContent = "Blip is resting.";
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handleClean() {
        applyDelta(0, +4, -3, +30);
        animatePet("action-clean");
        showBubble("Sparkly!");
        statusTextEl.textContent = "You cleaned Blip.";
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handlePet() {
        applyDelta(0, +10, 0, 0);
        animatePet("action-pet");
        showBubble("❤️");
        statusTextEl.textContent = "You gently petted Blip.";
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handleSurprise() {
        const roll = Math.random();
        if (roll < 0.35) {
          applyDelta(+10, +6, +4, +2);
          showBubble("Lucky!");
          statusTextEl.textContent = "A pleasant surprise for Blip.";
        } else if (roll < 0.7) {
          applyDelta(+4, +5, +4, 0);
          showBubble("Nice!");
          statusTextEl.textContent = "A small but nice surprise.";
        } else {
          applyDelta(-4, -5, -5, -4);
          showBubble("Oops...");
          statusTextEl.textContent = "The surprise startled Blip a bit.";
        }
        animatePet("action-play");
        saveState();
        updateUI();
      }

      function handleReset() {
        if (!confirm("Reset Blip and start fresh?")) return;
        state = {
          food: 75,
          happy: 80,
          energy: 65,
          clean: 80,
          createdAt: Date.now(),
          lastUpdated: Date.now()
        };
        saveState();
        updateUI();
        showToast("Blip has been reset.", "A fresh start together.");
      }

      function tick() {
        const before = {...state};
        applyTimeDecay();
        saveState();
        updateUI();

        const overallBefore = Math.round(
          (before.food + before.happy + before.energy + before.clean) / 4
        );
        const overallNow = getOverall();
        if (overallNow < 20 && overallBefore >= 20) {
          showToast("Blip is in critical shape.", "Several needs are very low.");
        } else if (overallNow < 40 && overallBefore >= 40) {
          showToast("Blip is having a rough time.", "Try tending to a few needs.");
        }
      }

      function init() {
        loadState();
        applyTimeDecay();
        saveState();
        updateUI();

        feedBtn.addEventListener("click", handleFeed);
        playBtn.addEventListener("click", handlePlay);
        sleepBtn.addEventListener("click", handleSleep);
        cleanBtn.addEventListener("click", handleClean);
        petBtn.addEventListener("click", handlePet);
        surpriseBtn.addEventListener("click", handleSurprise);
        resetBtn.addEventListener("click", handleReset);

        petEl.addEventListener("click", () => {
          handlePet();
        });

        tickIntervalId = setInterval(tick, 5000);
      }

      init();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
