question: minimalist-tamagotchi
prompt: Create the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for an interactive virtual pet simulation. Feel free to be creative with the pet's form (minimalist, abstract, etc.), its needs, and interactions. Provide visual feedback for actions and state changes. Store the pet's state in localStorage. The entire application must be a single-page self-contained HTML file.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Blobby - Virtual Pet</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --bg-primary: #1a1a2e;
            --bg-secondary: #16213e;
            --bg-card: #0f3460;
            --accent: #e94560;
            --accent-glow: rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.4);
            --text-primary: #eee;
            --text-secondary: #a0a0b8;
            --hunger-color: #ff6b6b;
            --happiness-color: #ffd93d;
            --energy-color: #6bcb77;
            --hygiene-color: #4d96ff;
            --social-color: #ff6ec7;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        /* Starfield background */
        .stars {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .star {
            position: absolute;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: twinkle var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes twinkle {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; }
            50% { opacity: 0.8; }
        }

        .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 95%;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        header {
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0 10px;
        }

        header h1 {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #ff8a80, #ffd93d);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .pet-info {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .pet-name-display {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .pet-name-display:hover {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .pet-age {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .mood-label {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin: 5px 0 15px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: color 0.5s;
        }

        /* Pet Arena */
        .pet-arena {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 280px;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom, #1a1a3e 0%, #0d0d1a 100%);
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .pet-arena .ground {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 60px;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(15,52,96,0.5), transparent);
            border-radius: 0 0 20px 20px;
        }

        .pet-arena .ground-dots {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 10px;
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .pet-arena .ground-dots span {
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        /* The Pet - Blobby */
        .pet-container {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 50px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .pet-shadow {
            width: 90px;
            height: 15px;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0,0,0,0.4), transparent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-top: -5px;
            transition: width 0.5s, opacity 0.5s;
        }

        .pet-body {
            position: relative;
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .blob {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
            position: relative;
            transition: background 0.8s, border-radius 0.5s, transform 0.3s;
            animation: blobIdle 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .blob.happy {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6bcb77, #4ecdc4) !important;
            animation: blobHappy 0.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .blob.sad {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2) !important;
            border-radius: 50% 50% 45% 45% / 55% 55% 45% 45%;
        }

        .blob.hungry {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b, #ee5a24) !important;
        }

        .blob.sleepy {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a29bfe, #6c5ce7) !important;
            animation: blobSleepy 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .blob.dirty {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b8860b, #8B7355) !important;
        }

        .blob.ecstatic {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd93d, #ff6b6b, #ff6ec7) !important;
            animation: blobEcstatic 0.3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .blob.dead {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #636e72, #2d3436) !important;
            border-radius: 60% 60% 40% 40% / 50% 50% 50% 50%;
            animation: none;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        @keyframes blobIdle {
            0%, 100% {
                transform: scaleX(1) scaleY(1) translateY(0);
                border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
            }
            25% {
                transform: scaleX(1.03) scaleY(0.97) translateY(2px);
            }
            50% {
                transform: scaleX(0.97) scaleY(1.03) translateY(-3px);
                border-radius: 48% 52% 52% 48% / 58% 62% 38% 42%;
            }
            75% {
                transform: scaleX(1.02) scaleY(0.98) translateY(1px);
            }
        }

        @keyframes blobHappy {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-2deg); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(2deg); }
        }

        @keyframes blobSleepy {
            0%, 100% {
                transform: scaleX(1.08) scaleY(0.92) translateY(5px);
                border-radius: 55% 55% 45% 45% / 50% 50% 50% 50%;
            }
            50% {
                transform: scaleX(1.05) scaleY(0.95) translateY(3px);
                border-radius: 53% 53% 47% 47% / 52% 52% 48% 48%;
            }
        }

        @keyframes blobEcstatic {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(5deg) scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Eyes */
        .eyes {
            position: absolute;
            top: 35%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .eye {
            width: 18px;
            height: 22px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .eye .pupil {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            background: #1a1a2e;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .eye .pupil .glint {
            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: absolute;
            top: 2px;
            right: 2px;
        }

        /* Eye states */
        .eyes.sleepy .eye {
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
        }

        .eyes.happy .eye {
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
        }

        .eyes.dead .eye {
            background: none;
        }

        .eyes.dead .eye::before,
        .eyes.dead .eye::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 16px;
            height: 3px;
            background: #636e72;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .eyes.dead .eye::before { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); }
        .eyes.dead .eye::after { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg); }

        .eyes.wide .eye {
            width: 22px;
            height: 26px;
        }

        /* Mouth */
        .mouth {
            position: absolute;
            top: 60%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 20px;
            height: 10px;
            border-bottom: 3px solid white;
            border-radius: 0 0 50% 50%;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .mouth.happy {
            width: 25px;
            height: 12px;
            border-bottom-width: 3px;
        }

        .mouth.sad {
            border-bottom: none;
            border-top: 3px solid white;
            border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0;
            height: 8px;
        }

        .mouth.open {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 3px solid white;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .mouth.dead {
            width: 20px;
            height: 0;
            border-bottom: 3px solid #636e72;
            border-radius: 0;
        }

        /* Blush */
        .blush {
            position: absolute;
            top: 52%;
            width: 15px;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 150, 150, 0.5);
            border-radius: 50%;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.5s;
        }

        .blush.left { left: 12%; }
        .blush.right { right: 12%; }

        .blush.visible { opacity: 1; }

        /* Zzz for sleeping */
        .zzz {
            position: absolute;
            top: -10px;
            right: -20px;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #a29bfe;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .zzz.visible {
            animation: floatZzz 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes floatZzz {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.5); }
            30% { opacity: 1; }
            100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-40px) scale(1.2); }
        }

        /* Sparkles */
        .sparkle-container {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .sparkle {
            position: absolute;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            animation: sparkleAnim 0.8s ease-out forwards;
        }

        .sparkle::before, .sparkle::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            background: #ffd93d;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .sparkle::before {
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .sparkle::after {
            width: 2px;
            height: 100%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        @keyframes sparkleAnim {
            0% { transform: scale(0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.5) rotate(45deg); opacity: 1; }
            100% { transform: scale(0) rotate(90deg); opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Floating hearts */
        .float-particle {
            position: absolute;
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: floatUp 1.5s ease-out forwards;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        @keyframes floatUp {
            0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.5); }
            100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-80px) scale(1.2); }
        }

        /* Stat Bars */
        .stats-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .stat {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        .stat-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .stat-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .stat-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 10px;
            transition: width 0.8s ease, background 0.5s;
            position: relative;
        }

        .stat-fill::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.3), transparent);
            border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
        }

        .stat-fill.critical {
            animation: pulseCritical 1s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulseCritical {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        /* Action Buttons */
        .actions {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .action-btn {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 15px 10px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.2);
        }

        .action-btn:active {
            transform: translateY(0) scale(0.95);
        }

        .action-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }

        .action-btn .icon {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .action-btn .label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .action-btn .cooldown-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 0%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            transition: height 0.3s;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Action ripple */
        .action-btn .ripple {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
            transform: scale(0);
            animation: ripple 0.6s linear;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        @keyframes ripple {
            to { transform: scale(4); opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Event Log */
        .log-container {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            max-height: 150px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .log-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }

        .log-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }

        .log-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .log-title {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .log-entry {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 4px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .log-entry:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

        .log-entry .log-time {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* Bottom controls */
        .bottom-controls {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .small-btn {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .small-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .small-btn.danger:hover {
            background: rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Toast notification */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            top: 20px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-100px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            z-index: 100;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .toast.show {
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }

        /* Name input modal */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 200;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .modal-overlay.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: all;
        }

        .modal {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 30px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 350px;
            text-align: center;
            transform: scale(0.8);
            transition: transform 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        }

        .modal-overlay.visible .modal {
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .modal h2 {
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }

        .modal p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .modal input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .modal input:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .modal button {
            background: var(--accent);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px 30px;
            color: white;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        }

        .modal button:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* Thought bubble */
        .thought-bubble {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            right: 20px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            color: #1a1a2e;
            padding: 8px 14px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0);
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
            pointer-events: none;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .thought-bubble.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .thought-bubble::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -8px;
            left: 30px;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 8px solid transparent;
            border-right: 8px solid transparent;
            border-top: 10px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
        }

        /* Pet color aura */
        .pet-aura {
            position: absolute;
            width: 160px;
            height: 160px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            filter: blur(30px);
            opacity: 0.3;
            transition: background 0.8s;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Poop indicator */
        .poop-container {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 30px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .poop {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            animation: poopAppear 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes poopAppear {
            from { transform: scale(0); }
            to { transform: scale(1); }
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 400px) {
            .actions {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .pet-arena {
                height: 240px;
            }

            .pet-body {
                width: 100px;
                height: 100px;
            }
        }

        /* Shake animation */
        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(0); }
            25% { transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-5deg); }
            75% { transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(5deg); }
        }

        .pet-container.shake {
            animation: shake 0.3s ease-in-out;
        }

        /* Feeding animation */
        .food-particle {
            position: absolute;
            pointer-events: none;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            animation: foodFall 1s ease-in forwards;
        }

        @keyframes foodFall {
            0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50px) rotate(0deg); }
            100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(60px) rotate(180deg); }
        }

        /* Level badge */
        .level-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #ff8a80);
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-left: 8px;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .xp-bar-container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 200px;
            margin: 3px auto 0;
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .xp-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #ffd93d);
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 0.5s;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Stars background -->
    <div class="stars" id="stars"></div>

    <!-- Toast -->
    <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

    <!-- Name Modal -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="nameModal">
        <div class="modal">
            <h2>🥚 A New Friend!</h2>
            <p>Your blob has hatched! What will you name it?</p>
            <input type="text" id="nameInput" maxlength="15" placeholder="Enter a name..." autofocus>
            <br>
            <button onclick="confirmName()">Let's Go!</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container">
        <header>
            <h1>🫧 Blobby Pet</h1>
        </header>

        <div class="pet-info">
            <span class="pet-name-display" id="petName" onclick="showNameModal()" title="Click to rename">Blobby</span>
            <span class="level-badge" id="levelBadge">Lv 1</span>
            <div class="pet-age" id="petAge">Just born!</div>
            <div class="xp-bar-container">
                <div class="xp-fill" id="xpFill" style="width: 0%"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="mood-label" id="moodLabel">Feeling happy! 😊</div>

        <!-- Pet Arena -->
        <div class="pet-arena" id="petArena" onclick="petPet(event)">
            <div class="sparkle-container" id="sparkleContainer"></div>
            <div class="thought-bubble" id="thoughtBubble"></div>
            <div class="poop-container" id="poopContainer"></div>

            <div class="pet-container" id="petContainer">
                <div class="pet-body" id="petBody">
                    <div class="pet-aura" id="petAura"></div>
                    <div class="blob" id="blob">
                        <div class="eyes" id="eyes">
                            <div class="eye">
                                <div class="pupil"><div class="glint"></div></div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="eye">
                                <div class="pupil"><div class="glint"></div></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mouth" id="mouth"></div>
                        <div class="blush left" id="blushL"></div>
                        <div class="blush right" id="blushR"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="zzz" id="zzz">Z</div>
                </div>
                <div class="pet-shadow" id="petShadow"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="ground">
                <div class="ground-dots">
                    <span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Stats -->
        <div class="stats-container">
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-header">
                    <span class="stat-label">🍕 Hunger</span>
                    <span class="stat-value" id="hungerVal">100</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-bar">
                    <div class="stat-fill" id="hungerFill" style="width: 100%; background: var(--hunger-color)"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-header">
                    <span class="stat-label">😄 Happiness</span>
                    <span class="stat-value" id="happinessVal">100</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-bar">
                    <div class="stat-fill" id="happinessFill" style="width: 100%; background: var(--happiness-color)"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-header">
                    <span class="stat-label">⚡ Energy</span>
                    <span class="stat-value" id="energyVal">100</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-bar">
                    <div class="stat-fill" id="energyFill" style="width: 100%; background: var(--energy-color)"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-header">
                    <span class="stat-label">🛁 Hygiene</span>
                    <span class="stat-value" id="hygieneVal">100</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-bar">
                    <div class="stat-fill" id="hygieneFill" style="width: 100%; background: var(--hygiene-color)"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat" style="grid-column: span 2;">
                <div class="stat-header">
                    <span class="stat-label">💜 Social</span>
                    <span class="stat-value" id="socialVal">100</span>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-bar">
                    <div class="stat-fill" id="socialFill" style="width: 100%; background: var(--social-color)"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Actions -->
        <div class="actions">
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnFeed" onclick="feedPet()">
                <span class="icon">🍕</span>
                <span class="label">Feed</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnPlay" onclick="playWithPet()">
                <span class="icon">🎾</span>
                <span class="label">Play</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnSleep" onclick="putToSleep()">
                <span class="icon">🌙</span>
                <span class="label">Sleep</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnClean" onclick="cleanPet()">
                <span class="icon">🛁</span>
                <span class="label">Clean</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnTalk" onclick="talkToPet()">
                <span class="icon">💬</span>
                <span class="label">Talk</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnTreat" onclick="giveTreat()">
                <span class="icon">🍬</span>
                <span class="label">Treat</span>
                <div class="cooldown-overlay"></div>
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Event Log -->
        <div class="log-container" id="logContainer">
            <div class="log-title">📜 Activity Log</div>
            <div id="logEntries"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Bottom Controls -->
        <div class="bottom-controls">
            <button class="small-btn" onclick="saveGame()">💾 Save</button>
            <button class="small-btn danger" onclick="resetPet()">🔄 New Pet</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // ==================== STATE ====================
        const DEFAULT_STATE = {
            name: '',
            hunger: 100,
            happiness: 100,
            energy: 100,
            hygiene: 100,
            social: 100,
            xp: 0,
            level: 1,
            born: Date.now(),
            lastUpdate: Date.now(),
            isSleeping: false,
            isAlive: true,
            poopCount: 0,
            totalInteractions: 0,
            log: []
        };

        let pet = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
        let cooldowns = {};
        let thoughtTimeout = null;
        let tickInterval = null;
        let autoSaveInterval = null;
        let isSleepingAnimation = false;

        // ==================== INIT ====================
        function init() {
            createStars();
            loadGame();

            if (!pet.name) {
                showNameModal();
            }

            updateDisplay();
            startGameLoop();

            // Track eye movement
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', trackEyes);
            document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                trackEyes({ clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY });
            });
        }

        function createStars() {
            const starsEl = document.getElementById('stars');
            for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
                const star = document.createElement('div');
                star.className = 'star';
                const size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
                star.style.width = size + 'px';
                star.style.height = size + 'px';
                star.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
                star.style.top = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
                star.style.setProperty('--duration', (Math.random() * 3 + 2) + 's');
                star.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 3 + 's';
                starsEl.appendChild(star);
            }
        }

        // ==================== SAVE/LOAD ====================
        function saveGame() {
            pet.lastUpdate = Date.now();
            localStorage.setItem('blobbyPet', JSON.stringify(pet));
            showToast('💾 Game saved!');
        }

        function loadGame() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('blobbyPet');
            if (saved) {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
                    pet = { ...DEFAULT_STATE, ...parsed };

                    // Calculate offline decay
                    const elapsed = (Date.now() - pet.lastUpdate) / 1000;
                    if (elapsed > 60 && pet.isAlive) {
                        const minutes = elapsed / 60;
                        const decayRate = pet.isSleeping ? 0.1 : 0.3;
                        const decay = Math.min(minutes * decayRate, 50);

                        pet.hunger = Math.max(0, pet.hunger - decay * 1.2);
                        pet.happiness = Math.max(0, pet.happiness - decay * 0.8);
                        pet.energy = pet.isSleeping
                            ? Math.min(100, pet.energy + minutes * 0.5)
                            : Math.max(0, pet.energy - decay * 0.5);
                        pet.hygiene = Math.max(0, pet.hygiene - decay * 0.6);
                        pet.social = Math.max(0, pet.social - decay * 0.4);

                        if (minutes > 5) {
                            pet.poopCount = Math.min(5, pet.poopCount + Math.floor(minutes / 15));
                        }

                        if (minutes > 2) {
                            addLog(`You were away for ${Math.floor(minutes)} minutes`);
                        }

                        checkDeath();
                    }

                    pet.lastUpdate = Date.now();
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('Failed to load save:', e);
                    pet = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
                }
            }
        }

        function resetPet() {
            if (!confirm('Start over with a new pet? Your current pet will be gone forever!')) return;
            localStorage.removeItem('blobbyPet');
            pet = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
            cooldowns = {};
            showNameModal();
            updateDisplay();
        }

        // ==================== GAME LOOP ====================
        function startGameLoop() {
            if (tickInterval) clearInterval(tickInterval);
            if (autoSaveInterval) clearInterval(autoSaveInterval);

            tickInterval = setInterval(gameTick, 3000);
            autoSaveInterval = setInterval(() => {
                pet.lastUpdate = Date.now();
                localStorage.setItem('blobbyPet', JSON.stringify(pet));
            }, 30000);
        }

        function gameTick() {
            if (!pet.isAlive) return;

            // Decay stats
            if (pet.isSleeping) {
                pet.energy = Math.min(100, pet.energy + 1.5);
                pet.hunger = Math.max(0, pet.hunger - 0.15);
                pet.happiness = Math.max(0, pet.happiness - 0.05);

                if (pet.energy >= 100) {
                    pet.isSleeping = false;
                    addLog(`${pet.name} woke up feeling refreshed! ☀️`);
                    showThought("Good morning! ☀️");
                }
            } else {
                pet.hunger = Math.max(0, pet.hunger - 0.25);
                pet.happiness = Math.max(0, pet.happiness - 0.15);
                pet.energy = Math.max(0, pet.energy - 0.12);
                pet.hygiene = Math.max(0, pet.hygiene - 0.1);
                pet.social = Math.max(0, pet.social - 0.08);
            }

            // Random poop
            if (!pet.isSleeping && Math.random() < 0.03 && pet.poopCount < 5) {
                pet.poopCount++;
                pet.hygiene = Math.max(0, pet.hygiene - 5);
                addLog(`${pet.name} made a mess! 💩`);
            }

            // Random thoughts
            if (!pet.isSleeping && Math.random() < 0.05) {
                randomThought();
            }

            checkDeath();
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function checkDeath() {
            if (!pet.isAlive) return;

            const criticalCount = [pet.hunger, pet.happiness, pet.energy, pet.hygiene, pet.social]
                .filter(v => v <= 0).length;

            if (criticalCount >= 3) {
                pet.isAlive = false;
                pet.isSleeping = false;
                addLog(`${pet.name} has passed away... 💔`);
                showToast(`💔 ${pet.name} has passed away...`);
                saveGame();
            }
        }

        // ==================== ACTIONS ====================
        function feedPet() {
            if (!canAct('feed')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');
            if (pet.isSleeping) return showToast('💤 Shhh... sleeping!');

            setCooldown('feed', 3000);

            const amount = 20 + Math.random() * 10;
            pet.hunger = Math.min(100, pet.hunger + amount);
            pet.energy = Math.min(100, pet.energy + 3);
            pet.hygiene = Math.max(0, pet.hygiene - 2);
            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(5);

            // Food particles
            const foods = ['🍕', '🍔', '🍎', '🥕', '🍰', '🧁'];
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const food = document.createElement('div');
                    food.className = 'food-particle';
                    food.textContent = foods[Math.floor(Math.random() * foods.length)];
                    food.style.left = (40 + Math.random() * 20) + '%';
                    food.style.top = '20%';
                    arena.appendChild(food);
                    setTimeout(() => food.remove(), 1000);
                }, i * 200);
            }

            showThought("Yummy! 😋");
            addLog(`Fed ${pet.name} - hunger restored!`);
            addRipple('btnFeed');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function playWithPet() {
            if (!canAct('play')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');
            if (pet.isSleeping) return showToast('💤 Shhh... sleeping!');
            if (pet.energy < 10) return showToast('😴 Too tired to play!');

            setCooldown('play', 4000);

            const amount = 25 + Math.random() * 10;
            pet.happiness = Math.min(100, pet.happiness + amount);
            pet.energy = Math.max(0, pet.energy - 12);
            pet.hunger = Math.max(0, pet.hunger - 8);
            pet.social = Math.min(100, pet.social + 10);
            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(8);

            // Sparkles!
            createSparkles(6);

            const container = document.getElementById('petContainer');
            container.classList.add('shake');
            setTimeout(() => container.classList.remove('shake'), 300);

            showThought("Wheee! 🎉");
            addLog(`Played with ${pet.name} - so much fun!`);
            addRipple('btnPlay');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function putToSleep() {
            if (!canAct('sleep')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');

            setCooldown('sleep', 5000);

            if (pet.isSleeping) {
                pet.isSleeping = false;
                showThought("*yawn* I'm up...");
                addLog(`Woke ${pet.name} up`);
            } else {
                if (pet.energy > 80) return showToast("Not tired yet! ⚡");
                pet.isSleeping = true;
                showThought("Good night... 💤");
                addLog(`${pet.name} went to sleep 🌙`);
            }

            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(3);
            addRipple('btnSleep');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function cleanPet() {
            if (!canAct('clean')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');
            if (pet.isSleeping) return showToast('💤 Shhh... sleeping!');

            setCooldown('clean', 4000);

            pet.hygiene = Math.min(100, pet.hygiene + 35);
            pet.happiness = Math.min(100, pet.happiness + 5);
            pet.poopCount = 0;
            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(5);

            // Bubble particles
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const bubble = document.createElement('div');
                    bubble.className = 'float-particle';
                    bubble.textContent = '🫧';
                    bubble.style.left = (30 + Math.random() * 40) + '%';
                    bubble.style.bottom = (20 + Math.random() * 20) + '%';
                    arena.appendChild(bubble);
                    setTimeout(() => bubble.remove(), 1500);
                }, i * 100);
            }

            showThought("So fresh! ✨");
            addLog(`Cleaned ${pet.name} - sparkling clean!`);
            addRipple('btnClean');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function talkToPet() {
            if (!canAct('talk')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');
            if (pet.isSleeping) return showToast('💤 Shhh... sleeping!');

            setCooldown('talk', 3000);

            pet.social = Math.min(100, pet.social + 20);
            pet.happiness = Math.min(100, pet.happiness + 8);
            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(4);

            const responses = [
                "Blob blob! 💕", "I love you! 🥰", "*happy wiggles*",
                "Tell me more! 👀", "Hehe! 😄", "*purrs contentedly*",
                "You're the best! 🌟", "Blob? Blob! 💬"
            ];
            showThought(responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)]);

            // Hearts
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const heart = document.createElement('div');
                    heart.className = 'float-particle';
                    heart.textContent = '💕';
                    heart.style.left = (35 + Math.random() * 30) + '%';
                    heart.style.bottom = (30 + Math.random() * 20) + '%';
                    arena.appendChild(heart);
                    setTimeout(() => heart.remove(), 1500);
                }, i * 150);
            }

            addLog(`Had a chat with ${pet.name}`);
            addRipple('btnTalk');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function giveTreat() {
            if (!canAct('treat')) return;
            if (!pet.isAlive) return showToast('💔 Your pet is no longer with us...');
            if (pet.isSleeping) return showToast('💤 Shhh... sleeping!');

            setCooldown('treat', 8000);

            pet.happiness = Math.min(100, pet.happiness + 15);
            pet.hunger = Math.min(100, pet.hunger + 10);
            pet.totalInteractions++;
            gainXP(6);

            // Star burst
            createSparkles(10);

            const treats = ['🍬', '🍭', '🍪', '🧁', '🍩'];
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            const treat = document.createElement('div');
            treat.className = 'food-particle';
            treat.textContent = treats[Math.floor(Math.random() * treats.length)];
            treat.style.left = '48%';
            treat.style.top = '15%';
            arena.appendChild(treat);
            setTimeout(() => treat.remove(), 1000);

            showThought("A TREAT?! 🤩");
            addLog(`Gave ${pet.name} a special treat! 🍬`);
            addRipple('btnTreat');
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function petPet(event) {
            if (!pet.isAlive || pet.isSleeping) return;

            pet.happiness = Math.min(100, pet.happiness + 3);
            pet.social = Math.min(100, pet.social + 2);

            // Create sparkle at click position
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            const rect = arena.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = event.clientY - rect.top;

            const sparkle = document.createElement('div');
            sparkle.className = 'sparkle';
            sparkle.style.left = x + 'px';
            sparkle.style.top = y + 'px';
            arena.querySelector('.sparkle-container').appendChild(sparkle);
            setTimeout(() => sparkle.remove(), 800);

            // Small heart
            const heart = document.createElement('div');
            heart.className = 'float-particle';
            heart.textContent = '💖';
            heart.style.left = x + 'px';
            heart.style.bottom = (rect.height - y) + 'px';
            arena.appendChild(heart);
            setTimeout(() => heart.remove(), 1500);

            updateDisplay();
        }

        // ==================== XP & LEVELING ====================
        function gainXP(amount) {
            pet.xp += amount;
            const xpNeeded = pet.level * 50;
            if (pet.xp >= xpNeeded) {
                pet.xp -= xpNeeded;
                pet.level++;
                showToast(`🎉 Level up! Now level ${pet.level}!`);
                addLog(`${pet.name} reached level ${pet.level}! 🎉`);
                createSparkles(15);
            }
        }

        // ==================== COOLDOWNS ====================
        function canAct(action) {
            return !cooldowns[action];
        }

        function setCooldown(action, duration) {
            cooldowns[action] = true;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn' + action.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + action.slice(1));
            if (btn) {
                btn.disabled = true;
                const overlay = btn.querySelector('.cooldown-overlay');
                overlay.style.height = '100%';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    cooldowns[action] = false;
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    overlay.style.height = '0%';
                }, duration);
            }
        }

        // ==================== DISPLAY ====================
        function updateDisplay() {
            // Name & Age
            document.getElementById('petName').textContent = pet.name || 'Unnamed';
            document.getElementById('levelBadge').textContent = `Lv ${pet.level}`;

            const xpNeeded = pet.level * 50;
            document.getElementById('xpFill').style.width = (pet.xp / xpNeeded * 100) + '%';

            // Age
            const ageMs = Date.now() - pet.born;
            const ageMinutes = Math.floor(ageMs / 60000);
            const ageHours = Math.floor(ageMinutes / 60);
            const ageDays = Math.floor(ageHours / 24);
            let ageText = '';
            if (ageDays > 0) ageText = `${ageDays} day${ageDays > 1 ? 's' : ''} old`;
            else if (ageHours > 0) ageText = `${ageHours} hour${ageHours > 1 ? 's' : ''} old`;
            else if (ageMinutes > 0) ageText = `${ageMinutes} min old`;
            else ageText = 'Just born!';
            document.getElementById('petAge').textContent = ageText;

            // Stats
            updateStat('hunger', pet.hunger);
            updateStat('happiness', pet.happiness);
            updateStat('energy', pet.energy);
            updateStat('hygiene', pet.hygiene);
            updateStat('social', pet.social);

            // Mood
            updateMood();

            // Pet appearance
            updatePetAppearance();

            // Poops
            updatePoops();

            // Log
            updateLog();
        }

        function updateStat(name, value) {
            const val = Math.round(value);
            document.getElementById(name + 'Val').textContent = val;
            const fill = document.getElementById(name + 'Fill');
            fill.style.width = val + '%';

            if (val <= 20) {
                fill.classList.add('critical');
            } else {
                fill.classList.remove('critical');
            }
        }

        function updateMood() {
            const label = document.getElementById('moodLabel');

            if (!pet.isAlive) {
                label.textContent = '💔 Passed away...';
                label.style.color = '#636e72';
                return;
            }

            const avg = (pet.hunger + pet.happiness + pet.energy + pet.hygiene + pet.social) / 5;

            if (pet.isSleeping) {
                label.textContent = '💤 Sleeping peacefully...';
                label.style.color = '#a29bfe';
            } else if (avg > 85) {
                label.textContent = 'Absolutely ecstatic! 🤩';
                label.style.color = '#ffd93d';
            } else if (avg > 70) {
                label.textContent = 'Feeling happy! 😊';
                label.style.color = '#6bcb77';
            } else if (avg > 50) {
                label.textContent = 'Doing okay 😐';
                label.style.color = '#74b9ff';
            } else if (avg > 30) {
                label.textContent = 'Not feeling great... 😟';
                label.style.color = '#fdcb6e';
            } else {
                label.textContent = 'Feeling terrible! 😢';
                label.style.color = '#e17055';
            }
        }

        function updatePetAppearance() {
            const blob = document.getElementById('blob');
            const eyes = document.getElementById('eyes');
            const mouth = document.getElementById('mouth');
            const blushL = document.getElementById('blushL');
            const blushR = document.getElementById('blushR');
            const zzz = document.getElementById('zzz');
            const aura = document.getElementById('petAura');
            const shadow = document.getElementById('petShadow');

            // Reset classes
            blob.className = 'blob';
            eyes.className = 'eyes';
            mouth.className = 'mouth';
            blushL.classList.remove('visible');
            blushR.classList.remove('visible');
            zzz.classList.remove('visible');

            if (!pet.isAlive) {
                blob.classList.add('dead');
                eyes.classList.add('dead');
                mouth.classList.add('dead');
                aura.style.background = '#636e72';
                shadow.style.opacity = '0.3';
                return;
            }

            shadow.style.opacity = '1';

            if (pet.isSleeping) {
                blob.classList.add('sleepy');
                eyes.classList.add('sleepy');
                zzz.classList.add('visible');
                aura.style.background = '#a29bfe';
                return;
            }

            const avg = (pet.hunger + pet.happiness + pet.energy + pet.hygiene + pet.social) / 5;

            // Determine primary state
            if (avg > 85) {
                blob.classList.add('ecstatic');
                eyes.classList.add('happy');
                mouth.classList.add('happy');
                blushL.classList.add('visible');
                blushR.classList.add('visible');
                aura.style.background = '#ffd93d';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else if (pet.hunger < 25) {
                blob.classList.add('hungry');
                mouth.classList.add('open');
                eyes.classList.add('wide');
                aura.style.background = '#ff6b6b';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else if (pet.energy < 25) {
                blob.classList.add('sleepy');
                eyes.classList.add('sleepy');
                aura.style.background = '#a29bfe';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else if (pet.hygiene < 25) {
                blob.classList.add('dirty');
                mouth.classList.add('sad');
                aura.style.background = '#b8860b';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else if (avg > 60) {
                blob.classList.add('happy');
                eyes.classList.add('happy');
                mouth.classList.add('happy');
                aura.style.background = '#6bcb77';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else if (avg < 40) {
                blob.classList.add('sad');
                mouth.classList.add('sad');
                aura.style.background = '#667eea';
                blob.style.background = '';
            } else {
                // Default/neutral
                blob.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #e94560, #ff8a80)';
                aura.style.background = '#e94560';
            }
        }

        function updatePoops() {
            const container = document.getElementById('poopContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < pet.poopCount; i++) {
                const poop = document.createElement('span');
                poop.className = 'poop';
                poop.textContent = '💩';
                container.appendChild(poop);
            }
        }

        function updateLog() {
            const entries = document.getElementById('logEntries');
            entries.innerHTML = '';
            const recentLogs = (pet.log || []).slice(-20).reverse();
            recentLogs.forEach(entry => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'log-entry';

                const time = document.createElement('span');
                time.className = 'log-time';
                const date = new Date(entry.time);
                time.textContent = date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

                const text = document.createElement('span');
                text.textContent = entry.text;

                div.appendChild(time);
                div.appendChild(text);
                entries.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        // ==================== EFFECTS ====================
        function createSparkles(count) {
            const container = document.getElementById('sparkleContainer');
            const arena = document.getElementById('petArena');
            const rect = arena.getBoundingClientRect();

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const sparkle = document.createElement('div');
                    sparkle.className = 'sparkle';
                    sparkle.style.left = (20 + Math.random() * 60) + '%';
                    sparkle.style.top = (10 + Math.random() * 60) + '%';
                    sparkle.querySelector?.('') // noop
                    container.appendChild(sparkle);
                    setTimeout(() => sparkle.remove(), 800);
                }, i * 80);
            }
        }

        function showThought(text) {
            const bubble = document.getElementById('thoughtBubble');
            bubble.textContent = text;
            bubble.classList.add('visible');

            if (thoughtTimeout) clearTimeout(thoughtTimeout);
            thoughtTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                bubble.classList.remove('visible');
            }, 2500);
        }

        function randomThought() {
            const thoughts = [];

            if (pet.hunger < 30) thoughts.push("I'm hungry... 🍕", "Feed me? 🥺", "*tummy rumbles*");
            if (pet.happiness < 30) thoughts.push("I'm bored... 😔", "Play with me? 🎾", "*sighs*");
            if (pet.energy < 30) thoughts.push("So sleepy... 😴", "*yawns*", "Need a nap...");
            if (pet.hygiene < 30) thoughts.push("I feel dirty... 🛁", "Bath time? 🫧", "*sniff sniff*");
            if (pet.social < 30) thoughts.push("I'm lonely... 💬", "Talk to me? 🥺", "*looks up sadly*");

            if (thoughts.length === 0) {
                const happyThoughts = [
                    "Life is good! 🌟", "I love you! 💕", "*wiggles happily*",
                    "What a great day! ☀️", "Blob blob! 🫧", "*bounces around*",
                    "Hehe! 😄", "This is nice... 💜"
                ];
                thoughts.push(...happyThoughts);
            }

            showThought(thoughts[Math.floor(Math.random() * thoughts.length)]);
        }

        function showToast(message) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.textContent = message;
            toast.classList.add('show');
            setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
        }

        function addLog(text) {
            if (!pet.log) pet.log = [];
            pet.log.push({ text, time: Date.now() });
            if (pet.log.length > 50) pet.log = pet.log.slice(-50);
        }

        function addRipple(btnId) {
            const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
            const ripple = document.createElement('span');
            ripple.className = 'ripple';
            const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
            ripple.style.width = ripple.style.height = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height) + 'px';
            ripple.style.left = '0px';
            ripple.style.top = '0px';
            btn.appendChild(ripple);
            setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
        }

        // ==================== EYE TRACKING ====================
        function trackEyes(e) {
            if (!pet.isAlive || pet.isSleeping) return;

            const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye .pupil');
            eyes.forEach(pupil => {
                const eye = pupil.parentElement;
                const rect = eye.getBoundingClientRect();
                const eyeCenterX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
                const eyeCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

                const angle = Math.atan2(e.clientY - eyeCenterY, e.clientX - eyeCenterX);
                const distance = Math.min(3, Math.hypot(e.clientX - eyeCenterX, e.clientY - eyeCenterY) / 30);

                const x = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
                const y = Math.sin(angle) * distance;

                pupil.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${x}px), calc(-50% + ${y}px))`;
            });
        }

        // ==================== NAME MODAL ====================
        function showNameModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('nameModal');
            const input = document.getElementById('nameInput');
            modal.classList.add('visible');
            input.value = pet.name || '';
            setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 300);
        }

        function confirmName() {
            const input = document.getElementById('nameInput');
            const name = input.value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                input.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent)';
                input.placeholder = 'Please enter a name!';
                return;
            }

            const isNew = !pet.name;
            pet.name = name;
            document.getElementById('nameModal').classList.remove('visible');

            if (isNew) {
                addLog(`${pet.name} was born! 🥚✨`);
                showToast(`Welcome, ${pet.name}! 🎉`);
            } else {
                addLog(`Renamed to ${pet.name}`);
                showToast(`Now called ${pet.name}!`);
            }

            saveGame();
            updateDisplay();
        }

        // Enter key for name input
        document.getElementById('nameInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmName();
        });

        // ==================== START ====================
        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
