<script>
(() => {
'use strict';
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const KEY = 'glomling.v1';
const DAY_MS = 120000; // one in-game day = 2 real minutes
const STAGES = [
  {d:0,  name:'Hatchling',  scale:.62},
  {d:2,  name:'Sproutling', scale:.8},
  {d:5,  name:'Juvenile',   scale:.96},
  {d:9,  name:'Luminary',   scale:1.1},
];
const NAMES = ['Miso','Pip','Mochi','Nori','Boba','Tofu','Pudding','Sprig','Clover','Biscuit','Fig','Waffle','Momo','Bean','Clover','Dumpling'];
const FOODS = {
  berry:{emoji:'🫐', label:'berry', h:22, e:2,  f:3,  c:-1, lines:['so juicy!','yum, a berry!','*happy munching*']},
  bun:  {emoji:'🥯', label:'bun',   h:36, e:6,  f:2,  c:-3, lines:['so hearty!','nom nom nom','belly is full!!']},
  candy:{emoji:'🍬', label:'candy', h:8,  e:4,  f:18, c:-9, lines:['SUGAR!! ✨','hehe, candy!','i can taste colors']},
};
const RATES = {h:.09, e:.06, f:.11, c:.05};
const CHIRPS = {
  happy:['la la la ♪','what a nice breeze','pet me? 👉','i love this meadow'],
  ecstatic:['best day ever!!','✨✨✨','i feel so glowy!','wheee!!'],
  hungry:['tummy is rumbling…','snack? 🥺','thinking about buns…'],
  tired:['so sleepy…','*yawn*','bed soon?'],
  icky:['i feel sticky…','bath time? 🫧','something smells…'],
  bored:['wanna play?','throw the stars! ⭐','hellooo? entertainment?'],
  sick:['not feeling so good…','need tonic 🍵','*sniffle*'],
};
const MOODS = {ecstatic:'🤩',happy:'😊',hungry:'🍽️',tired:'😪',icky:'🫧',bored:'😾',sick:'🤒',sleep:'🌙'};
const rand = (a,b) => a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const clamp = (v,a=0,b=100) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const pick = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];

/* ---------------- state ---------------- */
function freshState(){ return {v:1, hatched:false, taps:0, name:'', born:0, last:Date.now(),
  stage:0, sick:false, sleeping:false, muted:false, poops:[], stats:{h:100,e:100,f:100,c:100}}; }

function loadState(){
  try{
    const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));
    if(!d || d.v !== 1) return null;
    const el = Math.max(0,(Date.now()-d.last)/1000);
    if(d.hatched && el > 5){
      const away = Math.min(el, 21600);            // cap 6h
      const k = away * 0.15;                        // gentler offline decay
      const s = d.stats;
      if(d.sleeping){
        s.e = clamp(s.e + away*0.5);
        if(s.e >= 100) d.sleeping = false;
      }
      s.h = clamp(s.h - RATES.h*k); s.e = clamp(s.e - RATES.e*k);
      s.f = clamp(s.f - RATES.f*k); s.c = clamp(s.c - RATES.c*k - (d.poops.length*0.05*k));
      d._away = el;
    }
    return d;
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
let S = loadState() || freshState();
function save(){ S.last = Date.now(); try{ localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(S)); }catch(e){} }

/* ---------------- elements ---------------- */
const hab=$('#habitat'), fx=$('#fxLayer'), poopLayer=$('#poopLayer'), bubbleEl=$('#bubble'),
  petWrap=$('#petWrap'), petSvg=$('#petSvg'), eggWrap=$('#eggWrap'), eyesG=$('#eyesG'), mouth=$('#mouth');

/* ---------------- audio ---------------- */
let AC=null;
function ac(){ if(!AC){ try{ AC=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){} }
  if(AC && AC.state==='suspended') AC.resume(); return AC; }
function tone(f,d=.12,type='sine',v=.16,t=0,slide=0){
  const a=ac(); if(!a || S.muted) return;
  const o=a.createOscillator(), g=a.createGain(), t0=a.currentTime+t;
  o.type=type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t0);
  if(slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slide, t0+d);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t0); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,t0+.015);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t0+d);
  o.connect(g).connect(a.destination); o.start(t0); o.stop(t0+d+.05);
}
const SFX = {
  knock:()=>tone(160,.09,'square',.12),
  munch:()=>{tone(220,.08,'square',.11); tone(175,.09,'square',.11,.1);},
  purr:()=>{tone(520,.09,'sine',.11); tone(680,.13,'sine',.09,.08);},
  wash:()=>tone(600,.3,'sine',.1,0,1500),
  pop:()=>tone(480,.09,'triangle',.2,0,950),
  boing:()=>tone(190,.2,'sine',.15,0,430),
  sweep:()=>tone(900,.12,'sine',.08,0,300),
  sleep:()=>tone(330,.45,'sine',.1,0,130),
  wake:()=>{tone(440,.12,'triangle',.13); tone(660,.16,'triangle',.11,.12);},
  heal:()=>[523,659,784].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,.15,'triangle',.13,i*.09)),
  evolve:()=>[392,523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,.17,'triangle',.15,i*.1)),
  hatch:()=>[330,415,494,659,880].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,.18,'triangle',.15,i*.11)),
  error:()=>tone(130,.16,'sawtooth',.07),
};
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', ()=>ac(), {once:true});

/* ---------------- fx helpers ---------------- */
function habCenter(el){ const h=hab.getBoundingClientRect(), r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {x:r.left-h.left+r.width/2, y:r.top-h.top+r.height/2}; }
function spawnEmoji(ch,x,y,cls=''){
  const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='pt '+cls; d.textContent=ch;
  d.style.left=x+'px'; d.style.top=y+'px'; d.style.setProperty('--fx', rand(-26,26)+'px');
  fx.appendChild(d); setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1300);
}
function spawnFloat(txt,color,x,y){
  const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='fl'; d.textContent=txt;
  d.style.setProperty('--c',color); d.style.left=x+'px'; d.style.top=y+'px';
  d.style.setProperty('--fx', rand(-18,18)+'px');
  fx.appendChild(d); setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1400);
}
function confetti(x,y,n=26){
  const cols=['#ffd166','#ff8a70','#7de2a0','#8fd3ff','#c9b6ff'];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='pt confetti';
    d.style.left=x+'px'; d.style.top=y+'px'; d.style.background=pick(cols);
    d.style.setProperty('--dx', rand(-110,110)+'px');
    d.style.setProperty('--dy', rand(-130,40)+'px');
    d.style.setProperty('--rot', rand(-360,360)+'deg');
    fx.appendChild(d); setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1000);
  }
}
let bubbleT=null;
function say(txt, ms=2600){
  bubbleEl.textContent=txt; bubbleEl.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(bubbleT); bubbleT=setTimeout(()=>bubbleEl.classList.remove('show'), ms);
}
function log(msg){
  const li=document.createElement('li'); li.className='new';
  const t=document.createElement('span'); t.className='t';
  t.textContent=new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  const s=document.createElement('span'); s.textContent=msg;
  li.append(t,s);
  const ul=$('#logList'); ul.prepend(li);
  while(ul.children.length>8) ul.lastChild.remove();
}

/* ---------------- face & mood ---------------- */
const MOUTHS = {happy:'M94 126 Q110 142 126 126', flat:'M99 132 L121 132', sad:'M94 138 Q110 124 126 138'};
function setFace(m){
  petSvg.classList.remove('f-happy','f-ecstatic','f-hungry','f-tired','f-icky','f-bored','f-sick','f-sleep');
  petSvg.classList.add('f-'+m);
  mouth.setAttribute('d', (m==='happy'||m==='ecstatic') ? MOUTHS.happy : (m==='sad'||m==='bored'||m==='sick'||m==='icky') ? MOUTHS.sad : MOUTHS.flat);
}
function moodOf(){
  if(!S.hatched) return 'egg';
  if(S.sleeping) return 'sleep';
  if(S.sick) return 'sick';
  const s=S.stats;
  if(s.h<25) return 'hungry';
  if(s.e<22) return 'tired';
  if(s.c<25) return 'icky';
  if(s.f<25) return 'bored';
  if((s.h+s.e+s.f+s.c)/4 > 80) return 'ecstatic';
  return 'happy';
}

/* ---------------- UI ---------------- */
const cds={};
const cool=(k,ms)=>{ cds[k]=Date.now()+ms; };
const onCd=k=>cds[k] && Date.now()<cds[k];
let miniActive=false;

function updateUI(){
  const s=S.stats, m=moodOf();
  const map={h:['fH','vH','mH'], e:['fE','vE','mE'], f:['fF','vF','mF'], c:['fC','vC','mC']};
  for(const k in map){
    const [f,v,row]=map[k].map(id=>$('#'+id));
    f.style.width=s[k]+'%'; v.textContent=Math.round(s[k]);
    row.classList.toggle('low', S.hatched && s[k]<25 && !S.sleeping);
  }
  setFace(m==='egg' ? 'happy' : m);
  petWrap.classList.toggle('sickFilter', S.sick);
  $('#moodChip').textContent = m==='egg' ? '🥚 waiting…' : (MOODS[m]||'😊')+' '+m;
  hab.classList.toggle('hab-night', S.sleeping);
  petWrap.style.setProperty('--pscale', STAGES[Math.max(0,S.stage)].scale);
  petSvg.classList.remove('st0','st1','st2','st3');
  petSvg.classList.add('st'+Math.max(0,S.stage));
  $('#petGlow').style.opacity = S.hatched ? (S.stage>=3?1:.65) : 0;

  const asleep=S.sleeping, locked=!S.hatched;
  $('#btnSleep').disabled = locked;
  $('#btnPlay').disabled  = locked || asleep || S.sick || s.e<15 || miniActive;
  $('#btnWash').disabled  = locked || asleep || onCd('wash');
  document.querySelectorAll('.food').forEach(b=>b.disabled = locked || asleep || onCd('feed'));
  $('#btnTonic').classList.toggle('hidden', !S.sick);
  $('#sleepIco').textContent = asleep?'☀️':'🌙';
  $('#sleepLbl').textContent = asleep?'Wake up':'Sleep';
  $('#btnSound').textContent = S.muted?'🔇':'🔊';

  $('#nameBtn').textContent = S.hatched ? (S.name||'???') : '· · ·';
  if(S.hatched){
    const days=(Date.now()-S.born)/DAY_MS;
    $('#ageChip').textContent = 'Day '+(Math.floor(days)+1);
    $('#stageChip').textContent = STAGES[S.stage].name;
    $('#stageName').textContent = STAGES[S.stage].name;
    const next=STAGES[S.stage+1];
    if(next){
      $('#stageNext').textContent = '→ '+next.name+' in '+(next.d-Math.floor(days))+'d';
      $('#stageFill').style.width = clamp((days-STAGES[S.stage].d)/(next.d-STAGES[S.stage].d)*100)+'%';
    } else {
      $('#stageNext').textContent='fully grown ✿'; $('#stageFill').style.width='100%';
    }
  } else {
    $('#ageChip').textContent='Day —'; $('#stageChip').textContent='Egg';
    $('#stageName').textContent='Egg'; $('#stageNext').textContent='tap to warm it!';
    $('#stageFill').style.width=(S.taps/5*100)+'%';
  }
  eggWrap.style.display = S.hatched ? 'none' : 'block';
  petWrap.style.display = S.hatched ? 'block' : 'none';
}

/* ---------------- tick ---------------- */
let lastTick=Date.now(), saveCount=0;
function tick(){
  const now=Date.now(); const dt=Math.min((now-lastTick)/1000, 120); lastTick=now;
  if(S.hatched){
    const s=S.stats;
    if(S.sleeping){
      s.e=clamp(s.e+1.15*dt); s.h=clamp(s.h-RATES.h*.25*dt); s.c=clamp(s.c-RATES.c*.4*dt);
      if(s.e>=100) wake(true);
      if(Math.random()<dt*.12) { const p=habCenter(petWrap); spawnEmoji('💤', p.x+rand(-20,40), p.y-70); }
    } else {
      s.h=clamp(s.h-RATES.h*dt); s.e=clamp(s.e-RATES.e*dt);
      s.f=clamp(s.f-RATES.f*dt); s.c=clamp(s.c-(RATES.c + S.poops.length*.06)*dt);
    }
    const wasSick=S.sick;
    S.sick = s.h<=.5 || s.e<=.5 || s.f<=.5 || s.c<=.5;
    if(S.sick && !wasSick){ say('i don\u2019t feel so good…'); log((S.name||'your pet')+' fell ill 🤒'); SFX.sad?0:SFX.error(); }
    // growth
    const day=Math.floor((now-S.born)/DAY_MS);
    let target=S.stage;
    STAGES.forEach((st,i)=>{ if(day>=st.d) target=i; });
    if(target>S.stage) evolve(target);
  }
  if(++saveCount%5===0) save();
  updateUI();
}
setInterval(tick, 1000);

/* ---------------- actions ---------------- */
function feed(key){
  if(!S.hatched || S.sleeping || onCd('feed')) return;
  const F=FOODS[key], s=S.stats;
  s.h=clamp(s.h+F.h); s.e=clamp(s.e+F.e); s.f=clamp(s.f+F.f); s.c=clamp(s.c+F.c);
  const p=habCenter(petWrap);
  spawnEmoji(F.emoji, p.x, p.y-30);
  setTimeout(()=>{ spawnEmoji('✦',p.x-24,p.y-52); spawnEmoji('✦',p.x+22,p.y-60); },350);
  petWrap.classList.add('eating'); setTimeout(()=>petWrap.classList.remove('eating'),750);
  spawnFloat('+'+F.h+' 🍽️','#ff8a70', p.x-70, p.y-90);
  SFX.munch(); say(pick(F.lines)); log('ate a '+F.label+' '+F.emoji);
  cool('feed',3500);
  if(Math.random()<.32) setTimeout(spawnPoop, rand(2000,4500));
  save(); updateUI();
}
document.querySelectorAll('.food').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>feed(b.dataset.food)));

function spawnPoop(){
  if(!S.hatched || S.poops.length>=3) return;
  S.poops.push({x:rand(10,84), b:rand(6,18)});
  renderPoops(); SFX.knock(); say('oops… 🙈'); log('uh oh. a mess appeared 💩'); save();
}
function renderPoops(){
  poopLayer.innerHTML='';
  S.poops.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='poop'; b.textContent='💩';
    b.style.left=p.x+'%'; b.style.bottom=p.b+'%'; b.setAttribute('aria-label','Clean up');
    b.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
      ev.stopPropagation();
      b.classList.add('sweep'); SFX.sweep();
      S.stats.c=clamp(S.stats.c+5);
      spawnFloat('+5 🫧','#6fe3d4', ev.clientX-hab.getBoundingClientRect().left, ev.clientY-hab.getBoundingClientRect().top-10);
      log('cleaned up a mess ✨');
      setTimeout(()=>{ S.poops.splice(S.poops.indexOf(p),1); renderPoops(); save(); updateUI(); },420);
    });
    poopLayer.appendChild(b);
  });
}

$('#btnWash').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!S.hatched || S.sleeping || onCd('wash')) return;
  S.stats.c=100; S.stats.f=clamp(S.stats.f+3);
  const p=habCenter(petWrap);
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++) setTimeout(()=>{
    const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='pt bub';
    d.style.left=(p.x+rand(-70,70))+'px'; d.style.top=(p.y+rand(-10,50))+'px';
    fx.appendChild(d); setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1700);
  }, i*70);
  spawnFloat('squeaky clean!','#6fe3d4', p.x-40, p.y-100);
  SFX.wash(); say(pick(['so bubbly!','squeaky clean ✨','ahh, refreshing!']));
  log('had a bubbly bath 🫧'); cool('wash',6000); save(); updateUI();
});

$('#btnSleep').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!S.hatched) return;
  if(S.sleeping) wake(false);
  else {
    S.sleeping=true; SFX.sleep(); say('goodnight… 🌙'); log('tucked in for the night 💤'); save(); updateUI();
  }
});
function wake(auto){
  S.sleeping=false; SFX.wake();
  say(auto?'*stretch* fully charged!':'good morning!! ☀️');
  log(auto?'woke up fully rested':'was gently woken up');
  const p=habCenter(petWrap); spawnEmoji('☀️',p.x,p.y-90);
  save(); updateUI();
}

$('#btnTonic').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!S.sick) return;
  const s=S.stats; ['h','e','f','c'].forEach(k=>s[k]=Math.max(s[k],42));
  S.sick=false; SFX.heal();
  const p=habCenter(petWrap);
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++) spawnEmoji('✨', p.x+rand(-70,70), p.y+rand(-80,20));
  spawnEmoji('🍵',p.x,p.y-40);
  say('ahh… much better!'); log('drank a warm tonic 🍵'); save(); updateUI();
});

/* petting */
let lastPet=0;
petWrap.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(!S.hatched) return;
  if(S.sleeping){ say('mnh… five more minutes…',1600); return; }
  const now=Date.now();
  const gain = now-lastPet>1200 ? 2 : .4; lastPet=now;
  S.stats.f=clamp(S.stats.f+gain);
  const h=hab.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x=e.clientX-h.left, y=e.clientY-h.top;
  spawnEmoji('♥',x,y-6); setTimeout(()=>spawnEmoji('♥',x+rand(-16,16),y-16),140);
  SFX.purr();
  if(Math.random()<.2) say(pick(['hehe ♥','more please','*happy wiggles*','warm…']));
  if(moodOf()==='happy'||moodOf()==='ecstatic'){
    petSvg.classList.add('f-ecstatic'); setTimeout(updateUI,900);
  }
  save(); updateUI();
});

/* ---------------- mini-game ---------------- */
$('#btnPlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!S.hatched || S.sleeping || S.sick || S.stats.e<15 || miniActive) return;
  miniActive=true; updateUI();
  SFX.boing(); say('catch the stars!!');
  const counter=document.createElement('div'); counter.className='mgCounter'; counter.textContent='⭐ 0 / 5';
  hab.appendChild(counter);
  petWrap.classList.add('hop'); setTimeout(()=>petWrap.classList.remove('hop'),600);
  let caught=0, thrown=0;
  function throwStar(){
    if(thrown>=5){ endGame(); return; }
    thrown++;
    const st=document.createElement('button'); st.className='mstar'; st.textContent='⭐';
    st.style.left=rand(8,86)+'%'; st.style.top=rand(8,52)+'%';
    st.setAttribute('aria-label','Catch the star');
    let done=false;
    st.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(done) return; done=true;
      caught++; SFX.pop();
      S.stats.f=clamp(S.stats.f+6); S.stats.e=clamp(S.stats.e-2);
      const h=hab.getBoundingClientRect(), r=st.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x=r.left-h.left+14, y=r.top-h.top+14;
      spawnFloat('+6 ✨','#c9b6ff',x,y-10);
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++) spawnEmoji('✦',x+rand(-20,20),y+rand(-20,20));
      counter.textContent='⭐ '+caught+' / 5';
      petWrap.classList.add('hop'); setTimeout(()=>petWrap.classList.remove('hop'),600);
      st.remove(); updateUI();
      setTimeout(throwStar,320);
    });
    fx.appendChild(st);
    setTimeout(()=>{ if(!done){ done=true; st.style.transition='opacity .3s'; st.style.opacity='0';
      setTimeout(()=>{st.remove(); throwStar();},300);} },2200);
  }
  function endGame(){
    miniActive=false; counter.remove();
    if(caught>=5){ S.stats.f=clamp(S.stats.f+10);
      const p=habCenter(petWrap); confetti(p.x,p.y-40); say('ALL of them!! amazing!!');
      log('caught all 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐');
    } else { say(caught+'/5 — still fun!'); log('caught '+caught+'/5 stars'); }
    save(); updateUI();
  }
  setTimeout(throwStar,400);
});

/* ---------------- egg & naming ---------------- */
eggWrap.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(S.hatched) return;
  S.taps++; SFX.knock();
  eggWrap.classList.remove('wob'); void eggWrap.offsetWidth; eggWrap.classList.add('wob');
  $('#ck1').style.opacity = S.taps>=2?1:0;
  $('#ck2').style.opacity = S.taps>=3?1:0;
  $('#ck3').style.opacity = S.taps>=4?1:0;
  if(S.taps===3) say('something is moving inside…!',2000);
  if(S.taps>=5) hatch();
  save(); updateUI();
});
function hatch(){
  SFX.hatch();
  const p=habCenter(eggWrap);
  confetti(p.x,p.y,34);
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++) spawnEmoji(pick(['✨','🐣','✦']), p.x+rand(-60,60), p.y+rand(-60,20));
  eggWrap.classList.add('gone');
  setTimeout(()=>{
    S.hatched=true; S.stage=0; S.born=Date.now();
    S.stats={h:88,e:95,f:90,c:95};
    openName('hatch'); save(); updateUI();
  },500);
  log('the egg hatched!! 🐣');
}
let nameMode='hatch';
function openName(mode){
  nameMode=mode;
  $('#nameBig').textContent = mode==='hatch'?'🐣':'✏️';
  $('#nameTitle').textContent = mode==='hatch'?'Something hatched!':'Rename your pet';
  $('#nameSub').textContent = mode==='hatch'?'A tiny Glomling blinks up at you. What will you call it?'
    :'Every creature deserves a good name.';
  $('#nameInput').value = mode==='rename' ? S.name : '';
  $('#nameOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  setTimeout(()=>$('#nameInput').focus(),80);
}
$('#diceBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{ $('#nameInput').value=pick(NAMES); SFX.pop(); });
$('#nameOk').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const n=($('#nameInput').value.trim()||pick(NAMES)).slice(0,14);
  $('#nameOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  if(nameMode==='hatch'){
    S.name=n; save();
    const p=habCenter(petWrap); confetti(p.x,p.y,20);
    say('hi hi! i\u2019m '+n+'! ♥',3200); log('met '+n+' for the first time 🌱');
  } else { S.name=n; save(); log('is now called '+n+' ✏️'); say('i love it!'); }
  updateUI();
});
$('#nameInput').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') $('#nameOk').click(); });
$('#nameBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(S.hatched) openName('rename'); });

/* ---------------- reset / sound ---------------- */
$('#btnReset').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#resetOverlay').classList.remove('hidden'));
$('#resetNo').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#resetOverlay').classList.add('hidden'));
$('#resetYes').addEventListener('click',()=>{ localStorage.removeItem(KEY); location.reload(); });
$('#btnSound').addEventListener('click',()=>{ S.muted=!S.muted; if(!S.muted) SFX.pop(); save(); updateUI(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Escape'){ $('#resetOverlay').classList.add('hidden'); } });

/* ---------------- ambience ---------------- */
window.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{ if(!AC) ac(); },{once:true});
(function makeStars(){
  const box=$('#starsBox');
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){ const s=document.createElement('span'); s.className='nstar';
    s.style.left=rand(2,98)+'%'; s.style.top=rand(3,55)+'%';
    s.style.animationDelay=rand(0,2.6)+'s'; box.appendChild(s); }
})();
(function makeFireflies(){
  for(let i=0;i<11;i++){ const f=document.createElement('span'); f.className='firefly';
    f.style.left=rand(2,96)+'vw'; f.style.top=rand(5,92)+'vh';
    f.style.setProperty('--dur',rand(7,14)+'s'); f.style.setProperty('--del',rand(0,5)+'s');
    f.style.setProperty('--dx',rand(-60,60)+'px'); f.style.setProperty('--dy',rand(-70,40)+'px');
    document.body.appendChild(f); }
})();
/* eyes follow the cursor */
hab.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!S.hatched || S.sleeping) return;
  const h=hab.getBoundingClientRect(), p=habCenter(petWrap);
  const dx=clamp((e.clientX-h.left-p.x)/120,-1,1), dy=clamp((e.clientY-h.top-(p.y-30))/120,-1,1);
  eyesG.style.transform='translate('+(dx*4.5)+'px,'+(dy*3.5)+'px)';
});
/* ambient tap on the grass */
hab.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(!S.hatched || e.target!==hab && !e.target.closest('.night,.stars,.hills')) return;
  const h=hab.getBoundingClientRect();
  spawnEmoji(S.sleeping?'✦':'🌿', e.clientX-h.left, e.clientY-h.top-8);
});
/* blink loop */
(function blinkLoop(){
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(S.hatched && !S.sleeping && !petSvg.classList.contains('f-ecstatic')){
      petSvg.classList.add('blink'); setTimeout(()=>petSvg.classList.remove('blink'),150);
    }
    blinkLoop();
  }, rand(2200,5600));
})();
/* idle behaviours */
(function idleLoop(){
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(S.hatched && !S.sleeping && !miniActive){
      const r=Math.random(), m=moodOf();
      if(r<.28){ petWrap.classList.add('hop'); setTimeout(()=>petWrap.classList.remove('hop'),600); }
      else if(r<.6){ say(pick(CHIRPS[m]||CHIRPS.happy)); }
      if(m==='hungry'&&Math.random()<.5) spawnEmoji('🍽️', habCenter(petWrap).x+50, habCenter(petWrap).y-90);
    }
    idleLoop();
  }, rand(8000,16000));
})();
window.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{ if(document.hidden) save(); });
window.addEventListener('beforeunload',save);

/* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
renderPoops();
updateUI();
if(S.hatched){
  $('#ck1').style.opacity=$('#ck2').style.opacity=$('#ck3').style.opacity=1;
  log('you returned to the meadow 🌿');
  if(S._away && S._away>180) setTimeout(()=>say('you\u2019re back!! i missed you ♥',3400),700);
  else setTimeout(()=>say(pick(['hi!!','you\u2019re here!','*happy wiggle*'])),900);
} else {
  setTimeout(()=>say('an egg! tap it to keep it warm 🥚',4200),600);
  log('a mysterious egg appeared in the meadow…');
}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>LUMEN · containment unit</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   TOKENS
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#050e10; --bg2:#08171a;
  --panel:#0a1c1f; --panel-hi:#0e262a;
  --line:#1a373a; --line2:#265055; --line3:#3a7a7d;
  --ink:#e8f7f2; --dim:#82a5a0; --faint:#4e6d6b;
  --bio:#5ff2c0; --bio-d:#1f8f76; --cyan:#4bd6ff;
  --amber:#ffb648; --rose:#ff5a72; --violet:#a58bff;
  --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  --sans:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --disp:'Syne','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --sh:0 22px 48px -26px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);
  font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;
  overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}
button,input{font:inherit;color:inherit}
::selection{background:var(--bio);color:#03110f}

/* ============================================================
   AMBIENT BACKDROP (layered)
   ============================================================ */
.veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.veil__deep{
  position:absolute;inset:-10%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 55% at 18% 8%, #0d2b2c 0%, transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(60% 50% at 88% 22%, #10222e 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(80% 60% at 50% 110%, #0a2320 0%, transparent 65%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#061114,#040c0e 60%,#061013);
}
.veil__grid{
  position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.5;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right,rgba(90,190,175,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(90,190,175,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:46px 46px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 30%,#000 20%,transparent 78%);
}
.veil__beam{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-40vh;width:150vw;height:150vh;
  transform-origin:50% 40%;
  background:conic-gradient(from 200deg at 50% 40%,
    transparent 0deg, rgba(95,242,192,.055) 22deg, transparent 55deg,
    transparent 180deg, rgba(75,214,255,.045) 205deg, transparent 240deg);
  animation:sweep 44s linear infinite;filter:blur(6px);
}
@keyframes sweep{to{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
.veil__scan{
  position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.35;mix-blend-mode:overlay;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);
}
.veil__grain{
  position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.16;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='140' height='140'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3'/></filter><rect width='140' height='140' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.6'/></svg>");
  animation:grain 6s steps(6) infinite;
}
@keyframes grain{0%{transform:translate(0,0)}20%{transform:translate(-3%,2%)}40%{transform:translate(2%,-3%)}60%{transform:translate(-2%,-2%)}80%{transform:translate(3%,1%)}100%{transform:translate(0,0)}}

/* ============================================================
   TOP BAR
   ============================================================ */
.topbar{
  position:relative;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,26,29,.92),rgba(5,14,16,.72));
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}
.brand__mark{
  width:30px;height:30px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid var(--line3);position:relative;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#0d3b39,#061618);
  box-shadow:0 0 22px -4px rgba(95,242,192,.5), inset 0 0 12px rgba(95,242,192,.25);
}
.brand__mark::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:7px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,var(--bio),#1a7d66 70%);
  animation:breathe 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(.82);opacity:.75}50%{transform:scale(1.05);opacity:1}}
.brand__text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.05;min-width:0}
.brand__text b{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.14em}
.brand__text i{font-family:var(--mono);font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase}
.topbar__spacer{flex:1}
.meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;padding-right:16px;border-right:1px dashed var(--line2);margin-right:2px}
.meta:last-of-type{border-right:0}
.meta__k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase}
.meta__v{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.chip{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--dim);
  padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.chip:hover{color:var(--bio);border-color:var(--bio-d);background:rgba(95,242,192,.07);box-shadow:0 0 18px -6px var(--bio)}
.chip.is-off{opacity:.45;text-decoration:line-through}
.chip--warn:hover{color:var(--rose);border-color:#8d2f3d;background:rgba(255,90,114,.08);box-shadow:0 0 18px -6px var(--rose)}
@media(max-width:820px){.topbar{flex-wrap:wrap}.meta{border-right:0}}

/* ============================================================
   RIG LAYOUT
   ============================================================ */
.rig{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:236px minmax(0,1fr) 300px;
  gap:13px;padding:13px;height:calc(100dvh - 52px);
}
.panel{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel-hi),var(--panel) 40%,#071518);
  border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  position:relative;
}
.panel::before,.panel::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:9px;height:9px;border:1px solid var(--line3);pointer-events:none;
}
.panel::before{left:-1px;top:-1px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0}
.panel::after{right:-1px;bottom:-1px;border-left:0;border-top:0}
.hd{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 11px 7px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.hd::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line2) 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px)}
.hd b{color:var(--bio);font-weight:500}

/* --- left rail --- */
.rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.bond{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 12px 10px}
.bond__ring{position:relative;width:64px;height:64px;flex:none}
.bond__ring svg{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.bond__ring .val{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:17px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.bond__meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.bond__meta h4{margin:0;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.bond__meta p{margin:0;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);line-height:1.35}
.stagebadge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bio);
  border:1px solid var(--bio-d);padding:2px 6px;background:rgba(95,242,192,.08);
}
.alerts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:2px 11px 9px}
.alert{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:6px 8px;border-left:2px solid var(--amber);background:rgba(255,182,72,.07);color:#ffd690;
  animation:alertIn .3s ease both;
}
.alert.crit{border-left-color:var(--rose);background:rgba(255,90,114,.1);color:#ffb0bc;animation:alertIn .3s ease both, blink 1.1s steps(2,end) infinite}
.alert.good{border-left-color:var(--bio);background:rgba(95,242,192,.07);color:#a5f2d6}
@keyframes alertIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-8px)}}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.45}}
.log{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:6px 8px 10px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;min-height:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px}
.log li{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:3px 2px;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(38,80,85,.5);color:var(--dim);animation:logIn .35s ease both}
.log li time{color:var(--faint);flex:none}
.log li.k-good span{color:var(--bio)} .log li.k-warn span{color:var(--amber)}
.log li.k-bad span{color:var(--rose)} .log li.k-big span{color:var(--cyan)}
@keyframes logIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line2)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--line);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.stats div{background:#081a1d;padding:7px 9px}
.stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:16px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stats i{font-family:var(--mono);font-style:normal;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- chamber --- */
.stagecol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;min-height:0}
.chamber{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:280px;overflow:hidden;cursor:crosshair}
#cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.plate{position:absolute;left:16px;top:14px;pointer-events:none;z-index:3}
.plate__tag{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bio);
  display:inline-block;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(95,242,192,.35);padding-bottom:3px;
}
.plate__name{
  margin:4px 0 2px;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,54px);line-height:.92;text-transform:uppercase;
  text-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(95,242,192,.35);
}
.plate__sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase}
.ribbon{
  position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid var(--line2);background:rgba(6,20,22,.72);padding:5px 9px;
}
.ribbon i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bio);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--bio);animation:pulseDot 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulseDot{50%{opacity:.28;transform:scale(.7)}}
.ribbon[data-tone="warn"]{border-color:#7a5a24;color:var(--amber)} .ribbon[data-tone="warn"] i{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--amber)}
.ribbon[data-tone="bad"]{border-color:#7d2f3c;color:var(--rose)} .ribbon[data-tone="bad"] i{background:var(--rose);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--rose);animation-duration:.7s}
.ribbon[data-tone="cool"]{border-color:#2a5c72;color:var(--cyan)} .ribbon[data-tone="cool"] i{background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--cyan)}
.caption{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:14px;z-index:3;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;
  font-family:var(--sans);font-style:italic;font-size:12.5px;color:#9fc3bc;
  text-shadow:0 2px 14px #000;transition:opacity .5s;
}
.caption.out{opacity:0}
.flash{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.flash.go{animation:flashA .9s ease-out}
@keyframes flashA{0%{opacity:0}12%{opacity:.92}100%{opacity:0}}
.strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);flex:none}
.strip>div{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1f22,#08171a);padding:9px 11px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.strip .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);display:block}
.strip .v{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,29px);line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.strip .u{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);margin-left:3px}
.strip>div::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:2px;width:var(--p,0%);background:currentColor;opacity:.55;transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.strip>div{transition:transform .2s}
.strip>div:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* --- console --- */
.console{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto}
.console::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}.console::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line2)}
.gauges{padding:10px 11px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.gauge__top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:4px}
.gauge__k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.gauge__v{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--bio);transition:color .3s}
.gauge__track{
  position:relative;height:9px;background:#061518;border:1px solid var(--line);
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 4px) 0,100% 4px,100% 100%,4px 100%,0 calc(100% - 4px));
}
.gauge__track::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 9px,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 9px 10px);
}
.gauge__fill{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bio-d),var(--bio));
  box-shadow:0 0 12px -2px var(--bio);
  transition:width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), background .4s, box-shadow .4s;
}
.gauge.mid .gauge__fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a86b16,var(--amber));box-shadow:0 0 12px -2px var(--amber)}
.gauge.mid .gauge__v{color:var(--amber)}
.gauge.low .gauge__fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8a2131,var(--rose));box-shadow:0 0 14px -2px var(--rose);animation:lowPulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.gauge.low .gauge__v{color:var(--rose)}
@keyframes lowPulse{50%{filter:brightness(1.5)}}
.gauge.hint{padding-bottom:2px}
.gauge__hint{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase}

.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;padding:11px}
.act{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 10px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123134,#0b2023);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 9px) 0,100% 9px,100% 100%,9px 100%,0 calc(100% - 9px));
  transition:transform .14s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s;
}
.act:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--bio-d);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#174144,#0d272b);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -14px var(--bio)}
.act:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.act__led{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;background:#1d4145;transition:.2s}
.act:hover .act__led,.act.is-on .act__led{background:var(--bio);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--bio)}
.act__body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0;flex:1}
.act__label{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.act__sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.act__key{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--faint);border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:1px 4px;flex:none}
.act.is-on{border-color:var(--bio);box-shadow:0 0 26px -10px var(--bio), inset 0 0 22px -12px var(--bio)}
.act__bar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:2px;width:0;background:var(--bio);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--bio);transition:width .1s linear}
.act.nope{animation:nope .34s}
@keyframes nope{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-5px)}75%{transform:translateX(5px)}}
.act--ember{grid-column:1/-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a1a12,#241009);border-color:#7d3a22}
.act--ember .act__led{background:#5c2416}
.act--ember:hover .act__led,.act--ember.is-on .act__led{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--amber)}
.act--ember:hover{border-color:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -14px var(--amber)}
.act--ember .act__bar{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--amber)}
.act--hidden{display:none}
.scope-wrap{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 11px 11px}
.scope-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:5px}
.scope-hd span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.scope-hd em{font-family:var(--mono);font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:var(--bio)}
#scope{width:100%;height:64px;display:block;background:#051315;border:1px solid var(--line)}

/* ============================================================
   TOAST REPORT / INTAKE
   ============================================================ */
.report{
  position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:40;width:300px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d282b,#08191c);border:1px solid var(--line3);
  box-shadow:0 30px 60px -24px #000;padding:13px 14px;
  transform:translateY(140%);opacity:0;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1),opacity .4s;
}
.report.up{transform:none;opacity:1}
.report h5{margin:0 0 8px;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber)}
.report ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 10px;padding:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.report li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(38,80,85,.6);padding-bottom:3px}
.report li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.report p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;font-style:italic;color:var(--faint)}

.intake{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px;
  background:radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 40%,rgba(8,30,30,.86),rgba(2,8,9,.96));backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.intake[hidden]{display:none}
.intake__card{width:min(460px,100%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d2427,#081619);border:1px solid var(--line3);
  box-shadow:0 40px 90px -30px #000;padding:26px 26px 22px;position:relative;animation:cardIn .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1) both}
@keyframes cardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px) scale(.97)}}
.intake__orb{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 16px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%,#c9fff0,var(--bio) 32%,#137c68 62%,#052a24);
  box-shadow:0 0 60px -6px rgba(95,242,192,.7), inset 0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  animation:orb 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes orb{0%,100%{transform:scale(.9)}50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.intake h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(26px,5vw,38px);line-height:.95;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center}
.intake .lead{margin:8px 0 20px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.intake label{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:6px}
.intake input{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line3);padding:8px 2px;
  font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.02em;outline:none;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase}
.intake input:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--bio);box-shadow:0 6px 22px -18px var(--bio)}
.sugg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0 20px}
.sugg button{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:transparent;
  border:1px dashed var(--line2);color:var(--dim);padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s}
.sugg button:hover{color:var(--bio);border-color:var(--bio-d);border-style:solid;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.bigbtn{width:100%;padding:14px;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bio),#25a184);color:#03110f;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 12px,100% 100%,12px 100%,0 calc(100% - 12px));transition:.2s}
.bigbtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.12);box-shadow:0 14px 40px -14px var(--bio);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.bigbtn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.fine{margin:14px 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);font-style:italic}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */
@media(max-width:1180px){
  .rig{grid-template-columns:210px minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:minmax(320px,1fr) auto;height:auto}
  .console{grid-column:1/-1}
  .pad{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}

}

  .stagecol{order:-1}
  .chamber{min-height:64vh}
  .pad{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .gauges{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .strip{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}

}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

  <div class="veil__deep"></div><div class="veil__grid"></div><div class="veil__beam"></div>

</div>

  </div>
  <div class="topbar__spacer"></div>

<main class="rig">
  <!-- LEFT RAIL -------------------------------------------------->

                  stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="169.6" stroke-dashoffset="169.6"

      <div style="color:var(--cyan)"><span class="k">Growth</span><span class="v" id="rXp">0</span><span class="u" id="rXpNext">/180</span></div>

    <p class="fine">It will remember you. State persists in this browser.</p>

<script>
"use strict";
/* ==================================================================
   LUMEN — single-file virtual pet
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   state -> localStorage · canvas creature · instruments · audio
   ================================================================== */

const KEY = 'lumen.specimen.v3';
const NEEDS = ['nourish','lumen','stim','rest','purity'];
const NEED_META = {
  nourish:{label:'Nourish', hint:'nutrient density',  decay:0.055},
  lumen:  {label:'Radiance',hint:'stored light',      decay:0.045},
  stim:   {label:'Stimulus',hint:'enrichment / play', decay:0.038},
  rest:   {label:'Calm',    hint:'quiet-cycle reserve',decay:0.030},
  purity: {label:'Purity',  hint:'chamber cleanliness', decay:0.026}
};
const STAGES = [
  {tag:'SPARK',   name:'spark form',   scale:.56, eyes:0, tendrils:0, hue:170, xp:180,  bond:0},
  {tag:'BUD',     name:'bud form',     scale:.76, eyes:2, tendrils:3, hue:162, xp:560,  bond:22},
  {tag:'BLOOM',   name:'bloom form',   scale:.94, eyes:2, tendrils:7, hue:150, xp:1220, bond:48},
  {tag:'RADIANT', name:'radiant form', scale:1.10,eyes:3, tendrils:11,hue:188, xp:0,    bond:74}
];

/* ---------------- state ---------------- */
function fresh(){
  return {
    v:3, name:null, stage:0, born:Date.now(), lastSeen:Date.now(),
    needs:{nourish:74,lumen:66,stim:62,rest:82,purity:90},
    vitality:100, bond:6, xp:0,
    fugue:false, asleep:false, rekindle:0,
    counts:{feed:0,play:0,soothe:0,purge:0,beam:0,evolve:0,fugue:0},
    log:[]
  };
}
let S = load();

function load(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if(!raw) return fresh();
    const o = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!o || o.v!==3 || !o.needs) return fresh();
    const base = fresh();
    return Object.assign(base,o,{needs:Object.assign(base.needs,o.needs),counts:Object.assign(base.counts,o.counts)});
  }catch(e){ return fresh(); }
}
let saveTimer=0;
function save(){ S.lastSeen=Date.now(); try{ localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(S)); }catch(e){} }
setInterval(save,5000);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{ if(document.hidden) save(); });
window.addEventListener('beforeunload',save);

/* ==================================================================
   AUDIO  (tiny WebAudio blip synth)
   ================================================================== */
const A = { ctx:null, on:true, master:null };
function aInit(){
  if(A.ctx) return;
  try{
    A.ctx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    A.master = A.ctx.createGain(); A.master.gain.value=.16; A.master.connect(A.ctx.destination);
  }catch(e){ A.on=false; }
}
function blip(f=440,d=.12,type='sine',vol=1,slide=0){
  if(!A.on||!A.ctx) return;
  const t=A.ctx.currentTime, o=A.ctx.createOscillator(), g=A.ctx.createGain();
  o.type=type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);
  if(slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f+slide),t+d);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.9*vol,t+.012);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0008,t+d);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(A.master); o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+.02);
}
function chord(fs,d=.5){ fs.forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>blip(f,d,'triangle',.7),i*70)); }
let humNode=null;
function humOn(){
  if(!A.on||!A.ctx||humNode) return;
  const t=A.ctx.currentTime,o=A.ctx.createOscillator(),g=A.ctx.createGain(),l=A.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=A.ctx.createGain();
  o.type='sine'; o.frequency.value=112; l.type='sine'; l.frequency.value=5.4; lg.gain.value=14;
  l.connect(lg); lg.connect(o.frequency);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.32,t+.25);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(A.master); o.start(); l.start(); humNode={o,g,l};
}
function humOff(){
  if(!humNode) return; const {o,g,l}=humNode; const t=A.ctx.currentTime;
  g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t); g.gain.setValueAtTime(g.gain.value,t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.3);
  setTimeout(()=>{try{o.stop();l.stop()}catch(e){}},500); humNode=null;
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{aInit(); if(A.ctx&&A.ctx.state==='suspended')A.ctx.resume();},{once:false});

/* ==================================================================
   LOGGING
   ================================================================== */
const logEl=document.getElementById('log');
function note(m,k='n'){
  S.log.unshift({t:Date.now(),m,k});
  if(S.log.length>34) S.log.length=34;
  renderLogOne({t:Date.now(),m,k});
}
function renderLogOne(e){
  const li=document.createElement('li');
  li.className='k-'+e.k;
  const d=new Date(e.t);
  const hh=String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0'),mm=String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0'),ss=String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0');
  li.innerHTML=`<time>${hh}:${mm}</time><span>${e.m}</span>`;
  logEl.prepend(li);
  while(logEl.children.length>34) logEl.lastChild.remove();
}
function renderLog(){ logEl.innerHTML=''; [...S.log].reverse().forEach(renderLogOne); }

/* ==================================================================
   OFFLINE CATCH-UP
   ================================================================== */
(function catchUp(){
  if(!S.name) return;
  const elapsed = Math.min((Date.now()-S.lastSeen)/1000, 10*3600);
  if(elapsed < 90) return;
  const f=.4; // offline metabolism is slower
  const before = {...S.needs}, bv=S.vitality;
  NEEDS.forEach(k=> S.needs[k]=clamp(S.needs[k]-NEED_META[k].decay*elapsed*f,0,100));
  const avg = NEEDS.reduce((a,k)=>a+S.needs[k],0)/5;
  S.vitality = clamp(S.vitality - (avg<28? elapsed*0.012*(28-avg)*0.06 : 0) + (avg>62? elapsed*0.004:0),0,100);
  S.xp += elapsed*0.02*(avg/100);
  S.bond = clamp(S.bond - (avg<20? elapsed*0.0009:0),0,100);
  if(S.vitality<=0 && !S.fugue) enterFugue(true);
  // report
  const rows = NEEDS.map(k=>{
    const d=Math.round(S.needs[k]-before[k]);
    return `<li><b>${NEED_META[k].label}</b><span>${Math.round(S.needs[k])}% <em style="color:${d<-25?'var(--rose)':'var(--faint)'};font-style:normal">(${d})</em></span></li>`;
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('reportList').innerHTML=rows+
    `<li><b>Vitality</b><span>${Math.round(S.vitality)}% (${Math.round(S.vitality-bv)>=0?'+':''}${Math.round(S.vitality-bv)})</span></li>`;
  document.getElementById('reportLine').textContent =
    awayStr(elapsed) + ' alone. ' + (S.fugue? 'It withdrew into the dark.' : avg>62? 'It held up well.' : avg<28? 'It suffered. Attend to it.' : 'It drifted, waiting.');
  const rep=document.getElementById('report'); setTimeout(()=>rep.classList.add('up'),700);
  note(`returned after ${awayStr(elapsed)}`,'big');
})();
function awayStr(s){
  if(s<3600) return Math.round(s/60)+'m';
  const h=Math.floor(s/3600), m=Math.round((s-h*3600)/60);
  return h+'h '+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+'m';
}
document.getElementById('reportClose').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('report').classList.remove('up');

/* ==================================================================
   HELPERS
   ================================================================== */
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const TAU=Math.PI*2;

/* ==================================================================
   CANVAS SETUP
   ================================================================== */
const cv=document.getElementById('cv'), ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const chamberEl=document.getElementById('chamber');
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resize(){
  const r=chamberEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  W=Math.max(240,r.width); H=Math.max(200,r.height);
  cv.width=W*DPR; cv.height=H*DPR; ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(chamberEl); resize();

/* pointer */
const ptr={x:W/2,y:H/2,in:false,down:false,moveT:0,drag:0};
chamberEl.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  const r=chamberEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const nx=e.clientX-r.left, ny=e.clientY-r.top;
  if(ptr.down) ptr.drag+=Math.hypot(nx-ptr.x,ny-ptr.y);
  ptr.x=nx; ptr.y=ny; ptr.in=true; ptr.moveT=performance.now();
});
chamberEl.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{ptr.in=false;ptr.down=false;});
chamberEl.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{ptr.down=true;chamberEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);aInit();});
window.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{ptr.down=false;ptr.drag=0;});
chamberEl.addEventListener('dblclick',()=>sneeze());

/* ==================================================================
   CREATURE + PARTICLE SYSTEM
   ================================================================== */
const pet={
  x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,tx:W/2,ty:H/2,
  ph:rnd(0,9),ph2:rnd(0,9),breath:0,sq:0,tilt:0,tiltV:0,
  look:{x:0,y:0}, blink:1, blinkT:rnd(1.5,4),
  wanderT:0, pulse:0, pulseHue:160, joy:0, distress:0, tremor:0
};
const spores=[], motes=[], waste=[], sparks=[], rings=[], floats=[], tendrils=[];
for(let i=0;i<46;i++) spores.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),r:rnd(.6,2.2),s:rnd(.02,.09),p:rnd(0,TAU),d:rnd(-1,1)});
for(let i=0;i<11;i++) tendrils.push({a:i/11*TAU,len:rnd(.5,1),ph:rnd(0,TAU),sp:rnd(.5,1.4)});

let lure=null, beam=0, feedCool=0, purgeCool=0, playCool=0;
let soothing=false, irradiating=false, rekindling=false;

function baseR(){ return Math.min(W,H)*0.19*STAGES[S.stage].scale*(0.72+0.28*(S.vitality/100)); }
function moodIdx(){
  const n=S.needs;
  const avg=(n.nourish+n.lumen+n.stim+n.rest+n.purity)/5;
  return clamp((avg*0.55 + S.vitality*0.45)/100,0,1);
}
function disposition(){
  if(S.fugue) return 'fugue';
  if(S.asleep) return 'asleep';
  const n=S.needs;
  if(S.vitality<32 || pet.distress>.6) return 'distressed';
  const low=[['nourish',n.nourish],['lumen',n.lumen],['stim',n.stim],['rest',n.rest],['purity',n.purity]].sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1])[0];
  if(low[1]<26) return {nourish:'hungry',lumen:'dark',stim:'bored',rest:'tired',purity:'murky'}[low[0]];
  if(moodIdx()>.82) return 'ecstatic';
  return 'content';
}
const CAPTIONS={
  ecstatic:['humming at a frequency only you can hear.','radiating, and trying very hard to look casual about it.','it bumped the glass gently. that was a hug.'],
  content:['settled. cycling pleasantly through nothing.','a calm 0.9 hz pulse. it knows you are watching.','satisfied. the chamber is adequate, the hand is familiar.'],
  hungry:['nutrient density below comfort. it notices immediately.','it is watching the feeder. it has been watching the feeder.'],
  dark:['running low on light. it is dimming to compensate.','its glow has gone thin. irradiate, briefly.'],
  bored:['nothing to do. it invented a small, sad orbit.','it tried to chase its own signal. it failed.'],
  murky:['contaminants on the inner glass. it can taste them.','speckled. it keeps flinching at its own flecks.'],
  tired:['needs a quiet cycle. it is fraying at the edges.','blinking out of rhythm. dim it down.'],
  distressed:['containment stress. its waveform has teeth.','curled away from the glass. soothe it, patiently.'],
  asleep:['dreaming in slow interference patterns.','dormant cycle. do not feed a dreaming organism.'],
  fugue:['it has withdrawn into the dark.','rekindle sequence available. hold the ember.']
};
let capT=0, capKey='', capIdx=0;

/* ---------- spawning ---------- */
function spawnFood(n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    motes.push({x:rnd(W*.22,W*.78),y:-14-i*16,vx:rnd(-8,8),vy:rnd(24,52),r:rnd(3.4,5.6),ph:rnd(0,TAU),life:1});
  }
}
function spawnWaste(){
  const want=Math.round((100-S.needs.purity)/8.5);
  while(waste.length<want){
    waste.push({x:rnd(20,W-20),y:rnd(20,H-20),vx:rnd(-4,4),vy:rnd(-4,4),r:rnd(2,4.6),ph:rnd(0,TAU),a:0});
  }
  while(waste.length>want) waste.pop();
}
function burst(x,y,n,hue,pw=1){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rnd(0,TAU),sp=rnd(20,120)*pw;
    sparks.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:1,decay:rnd(.7,1.5),hue:hue+rnd(-14,14),sz:rnd(1,2.8)});
  }
}
function ring(x,y,max,hue,w=2){ rings.push({x,y,r:6,max,hue,a:1,w}); }
function floatText(x,y,t,col){ floats.push({x,y,t,col,life:1}); }

/* ==================================================================
   ACTIONS
   ================================================================== */
function actFeed(){
  if(S.fugue) return nope('feed');
  if(feedCool>0) return;
  if(S.asleep){ wake('startled awake by the feeder'); }
  feedCool=1.1;
  spawnFood(3+Math.floor(Math.random()*3));
  pet.pulse=1; pet.pulseHue=48;
  blip(320,.16,'sine',.8,120); setTimeout(()=>blip(460,.14,'sine',.6,80),110);
  flash('rgba(255,182,72,.30)');
}
function actPlay(){
  if(S.fugue) return nope('play');
  if(playCool>0||lure) return;
  if(S.asleep) wake('woken mid-dream');
  playCool=1.4;
  lure={x:rnd(W*.25,W*.75),y:rnd(H*.25,H*.7),vx:rnd(-60,60),vy:rnd(-40,40),t:9.5,caught:0};
  blip(700,.09,'square',.5,300);
  note('lure deployed','n');
}
function actPurge(){
  if(!waste.length || purgeCool>0){ if(!waste.length){ nope('purge'); note('no contaminants found','n'); } return; }
  purgeCool=.9;
  const take=waste.splice(0,Math.min(6,waste.length));
  take.forEach((w,i)=>setTimeout(()=>{
    burst(w.x,w.y,7,190,.7); S.needs.purity=clamp(S.needs.purity+6,0,100);
    S.xp+=3; blip(880+i*40,.07,'triangle',.4,-400);
  },i*70));
  S.counts.purge++; pet.pulse=1; pet.pulseHue=190;
  ring(pet.x,pet.y,Math.min(W,H)*.6,190,1.5);
  note('chamber purged · +purity','good');
}
function actRest(){
  if(S.fugue) return nope('rest');
  S.asleep=!S.asleep;
  if(S.asleep){ blip(200,.5,'sine',.5,-90); note('quiet cycle engaged','n'); }
  else { blip(420,.24,'sine',.6,180); note('cycle interrupted · awake','warn'); }
  flash(S.asleep?'rgba(20,40,80,.45)':'rgba(120,200,255,.18)');
  syncPad();
}
function actSoothe(on){
  if(S.fugue){ nope('soothe'); return; }
  soothing=on;
  if(on){ humOn(); pet.joy=Math.min(1,pet.joy+.3); }
  else humOff();
}
function actBeam(on){
  if(S.fugue){ nope('beam'); return; }
  irradiating=on;
  if(on) blip(1200,.18,'sawtooth',.25,600);
}
function actRekindle(on){
  if(!S.fugue) return;
  rekindling=on;
  if(on) blip(90,.6,'sawtooth',.5,60); else if(!humNode) {}
}
function wake(reason){ S.asleep=false; note(reason,'warn'); blip(500,.2,'sine',.5,-160); syncPad(); }
function nope(name){ const b=pad.querySelector(`[data-act="${name}"]`); if(b){b.classList.remove('nope');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('nope');} blip(150,.1,'square',.35,-60); }
function sneeze(){
  if(S.fugue) return;
  burst(pet.x,pet.y-pet.r*.4,26,STAGES[S.stage].hue,1.5);
  ring(pet.x,pet.y,Math.min(W,H)*.5,STAGES[S.stage].hue,2);
  S.needs.stim=clamp(S.needs.stim+4,0,100); S.needs.purity=clamp(S.needs.purity-2,0,100);
  S.xp+=2; pet.tremor=1; blip(240,.22,'triangle',.6,-160);
  note('it sneezed photons','good'); floatText(pet.x,pet.y-baseR()*1.4,'*achoo*','var(--cyan)');
}
function flash(col){ const f=document.getElementById('flash'); f.style.background=col; f.classList.remove('go'); void f.offsetWidth; f.classList.add('go'); }

/* ---------- fugue / rekindle ---------- */
function enterFugue(quiet){
  S.fugue=true; S.asleep=false; S.rekindle=0; S.counts.fugue++;
  pet.tremor=1; humOff();
  if(!quiet){ flash('rgba(255,90,114,.4)'); blip(180,1.4,'sawtooth',.6,-140); note('FUGUE STATE · it has withdrawn','bad'); }
  syncPad();
}
function revive(){
  S.fugue=false; S.rekindle=0; S.vitality=34; S.bond=clamp(S.bond-14,0,100);
  NEEDS.forEach(k=>S.needs[k]=Math.max(S.needs[k],42));
  flash('rgba(255,182,72,.55)'); burst(pet.x,pet.y,60,42,2.2); ring(pet.x,pet.y,Math.min(W,H),'42',3);
  chord([220,330,440,660],.7); note('rekindled. it remembers being cold.','big');
  syncPad();
}

/* ---------- evolution ---------- */
function evolve(){
  S.stage=Math.min(3,S.stage+1); S.counts.evolve++;
  const st=STAGES[S.stage];
  flash('rgba(95,242,192,.7)');
  burst(pet.x,pet.y,90,st.hue,2.6); ring(pet.x,pet.y,Math.max(W,H),st.hue,4);
  chord([330,440,550,740,990],.9);
  note(`METAMORPHOSIS → ${st.tag} form`,'big');
  pet.pulse=1.6; pet.pulseHue=st.hue;
  document.getElementById('pTag').textContent='specimen';
}

/* ==================================================================
   SIMULATION
   ================================================================== */
function simulate(dt){
  const n=S.needs;
  /* decay */
  if(!S.fugue){
    const asleep=S.asleep;
    NEEDS.forEach(k=>{
      let d=NEED_META[k].decay*dt*(asleep?(k==='rest'?-1.9:.42):1);
      n[k]=clamp(n[k]-d,0,100);
    });
    if(asleep) n.rest=clamp(n.rest+NEED_META.rest.decay*dt*1.9,0,100);
  }else{
    n.stim=clamp(n.stim-dt*.05,0,100);
  }
  /* holds */
  if(soothing && !S.fugue){
    n.rest=clamp(n.rest+dt*5.2,0,100);
    n.stim=clamp(n.stim+dt*1.1,0,100);
    pet.joy=Math.min(1,pet.joy+dt*.7); pet.distress=Math.max(0,pet.distress-dt*.5);
    S.bond=clamp(S.bond+dt*.22,0,100); S.xp+=dt*1.6; S.counts.soothe+=dt;
    if(Math.random()<dt*3.2) ring(pet.x,pet.y,baseR()*rnd(2,3.4),STAGES[S.stage].hue,1.2);
    if(Math.random()<dt*5) sparks.push({x:pet.x+rnd(-baseR(),baseR()),y:pet.y,vx:rnd(-12,12),vy:rnd(-40,-16),life:1,decay:.6,hue:STAGES[S.stage].hue+30,sz:rnd(1,2.2)});
  }
  if(irradiating && !S.fugue){
    beam=Math.min(1,beam+dt*2.4);
    const over=n.lumen>96;
    n.lumen=clamp(n.lumen+dt*(over?0:7.4),0,100);
    if(over){ S.vitality=clamp(S.vitality-dt*.9,0,100); n.purity=clamp(n.purity-dt*.9,0,100); pet.distress=Math.min(1,pet.distress+dt*.6);
      if(Math.random()<dt*2) note('over-exposure — release the beam','bad'); }
    S.xp+=dt*.5;
    if(Math.random()<dt*22) sparks.push({x:rnd(W*.3,W*.7),y:0,vx:rnd(-6,6),vy:rnd(60,150),life:1,decay:.8,hue:52,sz:rnd(.8,2)});
  } else beam=Math.max(0,beam-dt*1.8);

  if(rekindling && S.fugue){
    S.rekindle=clamp(S.rekindle+dt*13,0,100);
    if(Math.random()<dt*10) burst(pet.x+rnd(-20,20),pet.y+rnd(-20,20),2,42,.6);
    if(Math.random()<dt*3) humOn();
    if(S.rekindle>=100){ humOff(); revive(); }
  } else if(S.fugue){ S.rekindle=Math.max(0,S.rekindle-dt*7); }

  /* vitality + bond + xp */
  const avg=(n.nourish+n.lumen+n.stim+n.rest+n.purity)/5;
  if(!S.fugue){
    let deficit=0; NEEDS.forEach(k=>deficit+=Math.max(0,28-n[k]));
    if(deficit>0) S.vitality=clamp(S.vitality-dt*(.16+deficit*.016),0,100);
    else if(avg>62) S.vitality=clamp(S.vitality+dt*.32,0,100);
    S.xp+=dt*(.28+moodIdx()*1.15)*(S.asleep?.4:1);
    if(deficit===0 && avg>55) S.bond=clamp(S.bond+dt*.03,0,100);
    if(avg<18) S.bond=clamp(S.bond-dt*.05,0,100);
    if(S.vitality<=0) enterFugue(false);
  }
  pet.distress=clamp(pet.distress + (avg<30?dt*.12:-dt*.18),0,1);
  pet.joy=Math.max(0,pet.joy-dt*.28);
  pet.tremor=Math.max(0,pet.tremor-dt*.8);
  pet.pulse=Math.max(0,pet.pulse-dt*1.6);

  /* stage gate */
  const st=STAGES[S.stage];
  if(S.stage<3 && S.xp>=st.xp && S.bond>=st.bond && !S.fugue) evolve();

  /* cooldowns */
  feedCool=Math.max(0,feedCool-dt); purgeCool=Math.max(0,purgeCool-dt); playCool=Math.max(0,playCool-dt);
  spawnWaste();

  /* lure */
  if(lure){
    lure.t-=dt;
    if(ptr.in && ptr.down){ lure.x=lerp(lure.x,ptr.x,dt*6); lure.y=lerp(lure.y,ptr.y,dt*6); }
    else{
      lure.vx+=rnd(-160,160)*dt; lure.vy+=rnd(-120,120)*dt;
      const sp=Math.hypot(lure.vx,lure.vy); if(sp>130){lure.vx*=130/sp;lure.vy*=130/sp;}
      lure.x+=lure.vx*dt; lure.y+=lure.vy*dt;
      if(lure.x<28||lure.x>W-28) lure.vx*=-1; if(lure.y<28||lure.y>H-34) lure.vy*=-1;
      lure.x=clamp(lure.x,28,W-28); lure.y=clamp(lure.y,28,H-34);
    }
    if(Math.random()<dt*14) sparks.push({x:lure.x,y:lure.y,vx:rnd(-14,14),vy:rnd(-14,14),life:1,decay:1.6,hue:320,sz:rnd(1,2)});
    if(Math.hypot(lure.x-pet.x,lure.y-pet.y) < baseR()*.95){
      lure.caught++; S.counts.play+= (lure.caught===1?1:0);
      S.needs.stim=clamp(S.needs.stim+9,0,100); S.needs.purity=clamp(S.needs.purity-1.4,0,100);
      S.bond=clamp(S.bond+.5,0,100); S.xp+=7; pet.joy=1; pet.pulse=1; pet.pulseHue=320;
      burst(lure.x,lure.y,22,320,1.3); ring(lure.x,lure.y,120,320,2);
      floatText(lure.x,lure.y-14,'+9 stimulus','#ff8ab0');
      blip(rnd(600,900),.12,'square',.5,220);
      lure.x=rnd(40,W-40); lure.y=rnd(40,H-60); lure.vx=rnd(-90,90); lure.vy=rnd(-60,60);
      if(lure.caught>=4){ note('four catches — it is showing off','good'); lure.caught=0; }
    }
    if(lure.t<=0){ note('lure retracted','n'); lure=null; blip(260,.16,'sine',.35,-120); }
  }

  /* petting */
  if(ptr.down && ptr.in && !lure && !S.fugue){
    const d=Math.hypot(ptr.x-pet.x,ptr.y-pet.y);
    if(d<baseR()*1.7 && ptr.drag>0){
      S.needs.stim=clamp(S.needs.stim+dt*2.4,0,100);
      S.needs.rest=clamp(S.needs.rest+dt*1.4,0,100);
      S.bond=clamp(S.bond+dt*.12,0,100); pet.joy=Math.min(1,pet.joy+dt*.5);
      if(Math.random()<dt*10) sparks.push({x:ptr.x+rnd(-8,8),y:ptr.y+rnd(-8,8),vx:rnd(-20,20),vy:rnd(-46,-14),life:1,decay:1.1,hue:STAGES[S.stage].hue+40,sz:rnd(1,2.4)});
    }
  }

  /* food motes */
  for(let i=motes.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=motes[i]; m.ph+=dt*4;
    const dx=pet.x-m.x, dy=pet.y-m.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    const hungry=n.nourish<55?1.9:.9;
    if(m.y>H*.28){ m.vx+=dx/d*140*dt*hungry; m.vy+=dy/d*140*dt*hungry; }
    else m.vy+=90*dt;
    m.vx*=.985; m.vy*=.985; m.x+=m.vx*dt; m.y+=m.vy*dt;
    if(Math.random()<dt*6) sparks.push({x:m.x,y:m.y,vx:0,vy:8,life:.7,decay:2,hue:44,sz:1.2});
    if(d<baseR()*.82){
      motes.splice(i,1);
      S.needs.nourish=clamp(S.needs.nourish+7,0,100); S.xp+=4; S.counts.feed++;
      S.bond=clamp(S.bond+.12,0,100); pet.pulse=1; pet.pulseHue=44; pet.joy=Math.min(1,pet.joy+.25);
      burst(m.x,m.y,12,44,.9); ring(m.x,m.y,60,44,1.4);
      floatText(m.x,m.y-10,'+7 nourish','#ffd79a');
      blip(rnd(420,520),.13,'sine',.6,140);
      if(Math.random()<.3) note('absorbed a nutrient mote','good');
    } else if(m.y>H+40){ motes.splice(i,1); S.needs.purity=clamp(S.needs.purity-1.2,0,100); note('mote lost to the sump','warn'); }
  }

  /* sparks / rings / floats */
  for(let i=sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const s=sparks[i];
    s.x+=s.vx*dt; s.y+=s.vy*dt; s.vy+=42*dt; s.vx*=.97; s.life-=dt*s.decay;
    if(s.life<=0) sparks.splice(i,1); }
  for(let i=rings.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const r=rings[i];
    r.r+=(r.max-r.r)*dt*3.1; r.a-=dt*1.15; if(r.a<=0) rings.splice(i,1); }
  for(let i=floats.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const f=floats[i]; f.y-=dt*26; f.life-=dt*.85; if(f.life<=0) floats.splice(i,1); }

  /* ---- creature physics ---- */
  const R=baseR();
  pet.wanderT-=dt;
  if(S.fugue){ pet.tx=W/2; pet.ty=H*.6; }
  else if(lure){ pet.tx=lure.x; pet.ty=lure.y; }
  else if(S.asleep){ pet.tx=W/2; pet.ty=H*.66; }
  else if(pet.wanderT<=0){ pet.wanderT=rnd(2.4,5.5); pet.tx=rnd(W*.28,W*.72); pet.ty=rnd(H*.28,H*.62); }
  if(ptr.in && !lure && !S.asleep && !S.fugue){ pet.tx=lerp(pet.tx,ptr.x,.16); pet.ty=lerp(pet.ty,ptr.y,.16); }
  const k=S.fugue?1.2:(lure?5.2:2.2), damp=S.fugue?2.6:3.4;
  pet.vx+=((pet.tx-pet.x)*k-pet.vx*damp)*dt;
  pet.vy+=((pet.ty-pet.y)*k-pet.vy*damp)*dt;
  pet.x=clamp(pet.x+pet.vx*dt,R*.5,W-R*.5); pet.y=clamp(pet.y+pet.vy*dt,R*.5,H-R*.55);
  const sp=Math.hypot(pet.vx,pet.vy);
  pet.sq=lerp(pet.sq,Math.min(.22,sp/900)+Math.sin(performance.now()/620)*.05*(S.asleep?1.7:1),dt*6);
  pet.tiltV+=((-clamp(pet.vx/500,-.28,.28)-pet.tilt)*9-pet.tiltV*4)*dt; pet.tilt+=pet.tiltV*dt;
  pet.breath+=dt*(S.asleep?.7:1.5)*(1+moodIdx()*.4);
  pet.ph+=dt*.9; pet.ph2+=dt*.55;
  /* eyes */
  const lookTarget = ptr.in? {x:ptr.x-pet.x,y:ptr.y-pet.y} : (lure? {x:lure.x-pet.x,y:lure.y-pet.y}:{x:0,y:0});
  const ld=Math.hypot(lookTarget.x,lookTarget.y)||1;
  pet.look.x=lerp(pet.look.x,clamp(lookTarget.x/ld,-1,1),dt*7);
  pet.look.y=lerp(pet.look.y,clamp(lookTarget.y/ld,-1,1),dt*7);
  pet.blinkT-=dt;
  if(pet.blinkT<=0){ pet.blinkT=rnd(2.2,6)*(S.asleep?2.4:1); }
  const bt=pet.blinkT<.16? 1-Math.abs(.08-(pet.blinkT))/0.08 : 1;
  pet.blink = S.asleep?0.06:lerp(pet.blink, clamp(bt,0,1), dt*22);
}

/* ==================================================================
   RENDER
   ================================================================== */
function palette(){
  const st=STAGES[S.stage], m=moodIdx();
  let h=st.hue, sat=68, lig=58;
  if(S.fugue){ h=196; sat=8; lig=34; }
  else{
    h=lerp(st.hue-16,st.hue+18,m);
    if(pet.distress>.4) h=lerp(h,344,pet.distress*.55);
    sat=lerp(24,86,m*(1-pet.distress*.5));
    lig=lerp(34,64,m)*(0.55+0.45*(S.needs.lumen/100));
    if(S.asleep) lig*=.62;
  }
  return {h,sat,lig};
}
function blobPts(R,wobMul,t){
  const pts=[],N=18;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=i/N*TAU;
    const wob=Math.sin(a*3+t*1.5+pet.ph)*.05+Math.sin(a*5-t*1.05+pet.ph2)*.032+Math.sin(a*2+t*.62)*.026;
    const tremor=pet.tremor*Math.sin(a*7+t*22)*.06 + pet.distress*Math.sin(a*4+t*7)*.03;
    const g=1+(wob+tremor)*wobMul;
    const rx=R*g*(1+pet.sq*.5), ry=R*g*(1-pet.sq*.5);
    pts.push({x:Math.cos(a)*rx,y:Math.sin(a)*ry*1.04});
  }
  return pts;
}
function pathFrom(ctx,pts,ox,oy){
  const n=pts.length;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo((pts[0].x+pts[n-1].x)/2+ox,(pts[0].y+pts[n-1].y)/2+oy);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const p=pts[i],q=pts[(i+1)%n];
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x+ox,p.y+oy,(p.x+q.x)/2+ox,(p.y+q.y)/2+oy);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
}
function draw(t,dt){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  /* --- tank --- */
  const bg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H*.42,10,W*.5,H*.5,Math.max(W,H)*.78);
  const P=palette();
  bg.addColorStop(0,`hsl(${P.h} 34% ${S.asleep?5:9}%)`);
  bg.addColorStop(.55,'#061518'); bg.addColorStop(1,'#030d0f');
  ctx.fillStyle=bg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,200,190,.045)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let y=H*.86;y<H;y+=14){ ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke(); }
  /* --- spores --- */
  spores.forEach(s=>{
    s.p+=dt*s.s*3;
    const x=((s.x+Math.sin(s.p)*.02+s.d*t*.004)%1+1)%1, y=((s.y - t*s.s*.012)%1+1)%1;
    const a=(S.fugue?.10:.16+.4*(S.needs.lumen/100))*(0.4+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.p)));
    ctx.fillStyle=`hsla(${P.h} 80% 72% / ${a})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x*W,y*H,s.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  });
  /* --- beam --- */
  if(beam>0.01){
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(W*.5,0,W*.5,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,228,168,${.30*beam})`);
    g.addColorStop(.55,`rgba(255,196,110,${.10*beam})`);
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,190,90,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W*.5-W*.07,0); ctx.lineTo(W*.5+W*.07,0);
    ctx.lineTo(W*.5+W*.30,H); ctx.lineTo(W*.5-W*.30,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,232,190,${.5*beam})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W*.5,4,W*.075,9,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  /* --- waste --- */
  waste.forEach(w=>{
    w.ph+=dt*.8; w.a=Math.min(1,w.a+dt*.7);
    w.x+=Math.sin(w.ph)*dt*7; w.y+=Math.cos(w.ph*.7)*dt*6;
    w.x=clamp(w.x,10,W-10); w.y=clamp(w.y,10,H-10);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(46,58,52,${.85*w.a})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(w.x,w.y,w.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(12,20,18,${.6*w.a})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(w.x+w.r*.3,w.y-w.r*.25,w.r*.5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  });

  /* =================== THE ORGANISM =================== */
  const R=baseR();
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(pet.x,pet.y); ctx.rotate(pet.tilt);
  const pts=blobPts(R,1,t);
  /* glow layers */
  [[2.35,.055],[1.72,.085],[1.28,.14]].forEach(([m,a])=>{
    ctx.save(); ctx.scale(m,m);
    ctx.fillStyle=`hsla(${P.h} ${P.sat}% ${Math.min(80,P.lig+18)}% / ${a*(S.fugue?.5:1)})`;
    pathFrom(ctx,pts,0,0); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
  });
  /* tendrils */
  const tn=STAGES[S.stage].tendrils;
  if(tn){
    ctx.lineCap='round';
    for(let i=0;i<tn;i++){
      const td=tendrils[i%tendrils.length];
      const a=td.a+t*.05*(i%2?1:-1);
      const len=R*(1.15+td.len*.55+Math.sin(t*td.sp+td.ph)*.12)*(S.asleep?.6:1);
      const x0=Math.cos(a)*R*.92,y0=Math.sin(a)*R*.92;
      const cx=Math.cos(a+.5)*len*.75, cy=Math.sin(a+.5)*len*.75;
      const x1=Math.cos(a+.25+Math.sin(t*td.sp+td.ph)*.4)*len, y1=Math.sin(a+.25+Math.sin(t*td.sp+td.ph)*.4)*len;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${P.h} ${P.sat}% ${P.lig+14}% / ${S.fugue?.18:.5})`;
      ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,R*.055);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0,y0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx,cy,x1,y1); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=`hsla(${P.h+20} 90% 76% / ${S.fugue?.2:.75})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x1,y1,Math.max(1,R*.05),0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  /* body */
  const body=ctx.createRadialGradient(-R*.28,-R*.34,R*.06,0,0,R*1.18);
  body.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${P.h+14} ${Math.min(96,P.sat+18)}% ${Math.min(88,P.lig+30)}% / .98)`);
  body.addColorStop(.45,`hsla(${P.h} ${P.sat}% ${P.lig}% / .92)`);
  body.addColorStop(1,`hsla(${P.h-22} ${P.sat*.8}% ${Math.max(8,P.lig*.34)}% / .92)`);
  ctx.fillStyle=body; pathFrom(ctx,pts,0,0); ctx.fill();
  /* rim */
  ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${P.h+24} 92% ${Math.min(88,P.lig+28)}% / ${S.fugue?.25:.65})`;
  ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,R*.035); ctx.stroke();
  /* pulse feedback */
  if(pet.pulse>0.01){
    ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${pet.pulseHue} 95% 74% / ${pet.pulse*.7})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=2+pet.pulse*3; pathFrom(ctx,blobPts(R*(1+pet.pulse*.18),1,t),0,0); ctx.stroke();
  }
  /* nucleus */
  const nr=R*.34*(1+Math.sin(pet.breath)*.07);
  const nuc=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,nr*1.5);
  nuc.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${P.h+30} 100% ${S.fugue?42:88}% / ${S.fugue?.4:.95})`);
  nuc.addColorStop(.6,`hsla(${P.h+8} 90% ${P.lig+10}% / .5)`);
  nuc.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=nuc; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,nr*1.5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.save(); ctx.rotate(t*.35);
  ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${P.h+40} 96% 82% / ${S.fugue?.12:.42})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,nr*(.55+i*.2),nr*(.22+i*.1),i*1.1,0,TAU); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.restore();
  /* face */
  const md=moodIdx(), eyes=STAGES[S.stage].eyes;
  if(eyes){
    const ey=-R*.16, ex=R*.30, er=Math.max(3.2,R*.135);
    const look=eyes===3?[[0,-R*.34,ex*1.0],[ -ex,ey,1],[ex,ey,1]]:[[ -ex,ey,1],[ex,ey,1]];
    look.forEach(([ox,oy,sc],idx)=>{
      if(eyes===3&&idx===0){ }
      const r=er*(idx===0&&eyes===3?.85:1);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(3,16,16,.82)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ox,oy,r*1.06,r*(1.02*pet.blink+.04),0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      const px=ox+pet.look.x*r*.34, py=oy+pet.look.y*r*.34;
      const ig=ctx.createRadialGradient(px-r*.25,py-r*.25,0,px,py,r*.82);
      ig.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${P.h+46} 100% 92% / ${S.fugue?.3:1})`);
      ig.addColorStop(.55,`hsla(${P.h+18} 96% ${S.fugue?30:66}% / ${S.fugue?.35:1})`);
      ig.addColorStop(1,`hsla(${P.h-10} 80% 26% / ${S.fugue?.3:1})`);
      ctx.fillStyle=ig;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px,py,r*.76,r*.76*(pet.blink*.9+.1),0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.75*pet.blink*(S.fugue?.2:1)})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px-r*.28,py-r*.3,r*.17,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    });
    /* mouth */
    const my=R*.24, mw=R*.34;
    const curve=(pet.joy*.6+md*.7-.34-(S.fugue?.5:0))*R*.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(3,18,18,${S.fugue?.4:.75})`; ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1.6,R*.05); ctx.lineCap='round';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-mw,my); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,my+curve,mw,my); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${P.h+40} 100% 86% / ${S.fugue?.15:.5})`; ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,R*.028);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-mw,my); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,my+curve,mw,my); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  /* shadow / reflection */
  ctx.save();
  const sh=ctx.createRadialGradient(pet.x,H*.97,2,pet.x,H*.97,R*1.5);
  sh.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${P.h} 60% 50% / ${S.fugue?.05:.14})`); sh.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=sh; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(pet.x,H*.96,R*1.4,R*.2,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  /* food motes */
  motes.forEach(m=>{
    const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x,m.y,0,m.x,m.y,m.r*3.2);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,236,190,.95)'); g.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(255,178,64,.75)'); g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r*3.2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff0cf'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r*(1+Math.sin(m.ph)*.12),0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  });
  /* lure */
  if(lure){
    const lp=1+Math.sin(t*9)*.16;
    const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(lure.x,lure.y,0,lure.x,lure.y,16*lp);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#fff'); g.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,120,180,.9)'); g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lure.x,lure.y,16*lp,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,150,200,.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lure.x,lure.y,10+Math.sin(t*4)*3,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
  }
  /* rings */
  rings.forEach(r=>{
    ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${r.hue} 92% 74% / ${Math.max(0,r.a)*.55})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=r.w; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
  });
  /* sparks */
  sparks.forEach(s=>{
    ctx.fillStyle=`hsla(${s.hue} 96% 76% / ${Math.max(0,s.life)})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.sz*Math.max(.2,s.life),0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  });
  /* floats */
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  floats.forEach(f=>{
    ctx.font='600 11px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle=f.col.replace(/[\d.]+\)$/,Math.max(0,f.life)+')');
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,f.life); ctx.fillStyle=f.col;
    ctx.fillText(f.t,f.x,f.y); ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  });
  /* glass sheen + vignette */
  const sheen=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W*.6,H);
  sheen.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.045)'); sheen.addColorStop(.16,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=sheen; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const vg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H*.5,Math.min(W,H)*.3,W*.5,H*.5,Math.max(W,H)*.72);
  vg.addColorStop(0,'transparent'); vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.62)');
  ctx.fillStyle=vg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(S.fugue){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,10,14,.34)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(200,230,225,${Math.random()*.06})`;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.random()*W,Math.random()*H,Math.random()*22,1); }
  }
  /* rekindle progress arc */
  if(S.fugue && S.rekindle>0){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,182,72,.9)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pet.x,pet.y,R+22,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+TAU*S.rekindle/100); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font='600 10px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,214,150,.9)';
    ctx.fillText('REKINDLING '+Math.round(S.rekindle)+'%',pet.x,pet.y+R+44);
  }
}
