const sc=document.getElementById('scope'), sctx=sc.getContext('2d');
let hist=new Array(150).fill(0), scT=0;
function scResize(){ const r=sc.getBoundingClientRect(); sc.width=r.width*2; sc.height=128; }
new ResizeObserver(scResize).observe(sc); scResize();
function drawScope(t,dt){
  const w=sc.width,h=sc.height, md=moodIdx();
  scT+=dt;
  const freq=(0.6+md*2.4);
  const amp=(0.16+md*0.34)*(1+pet.joy*.5);
  const jag=pet.distress*(S.fugue?0:1)+pet.tremor;
  const v=Math.sin(t*freq*TAU*.6)*amp + Math.sin(t*freq*2.7)*amp*.3*jag + (Math.random()-.5)*(.03+jag*.5) + pet.pulse*.4*Math.sin(t*30);
  hist.push(clamp(v,-1.2,1.2)); hist.shift();
  sctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  sctx.fillStyle='#051315'; sctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  sctx.strokeStyle='rgba(90,150,145,.14)'; sctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<w;x+=w/8){ sctx.beginPath();sctx.moveTo(x,0);sctx.lineTo(x,h);sctx.stroke(); }
  for(let y=0;y<h;y+=h/4){ sctx.beginPath();sctx.moveTo(0,y);sctx.lineTo(w,y);sctx.stroke(); }
  const P=palette();
  sctx.shadowBlur=8; sctx.shadowColor=`hsl(${P.h} 90% 60%)`;
  sctx.strokeStyle=S.fugue?'#4a6a6a':`hsl(${P.h} 92% 66%)`; sctx.lineWidth=2;
  sctx.beginPath();
  hist.forEach((val,i)=>{ const x=i/(hist.length-1)*w, y=h/2-val*h*.42; i?sctx.lineTo(x,y):sctx.moveTo(x,y); });
  sctx.stroke(); sctx.shadowBlur=0;
  sctx.fillStyle=`hsl(${P.h} 95% 80%)`; sctx.beginPath(); sctx.arc(w-1,h/2-hist[hist.length-1]*h*.42,2.4,0,TAU); sctx.fill();
  document.getElementById('scopeHz').textContent=(S.fugue?'—':(freq*.6).toFixed(2))+' hz';
}

  pad.appendChild(b); padEls[a.id]={el:b,bar:b.querySelector('.act__bar')};
  if(a.hold){
    let on=false;
    const down=e=>{ e.preventDefault(); if(on)return; on=true; b.classList.add('is-on'); actFn(a.id,true); };
    const up=()=>{ if(!on)return; on=false; b.classList.remove('is-on'); actFn(a.id,false); };
    b.addEventListener('pointerdown',down); window.addEventListener('pointerup',up);
    b.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
    a._set=v=>{ if(v&&!on){on=true;b.classList.add('is-on');actFn(a.id,true);} else if(!v&&on){on=false;b.classList.remove('is-on');actFn(a.id,false);} };

  }

function actFn(id,v){
  aInit();
  switch(id){
    case 'feed': actFeed(); break;
    case 'play': actPlay(); break;
    case 'purge': actPurge(); break;
    case 'rest': actRest(); break;
    case 'soothe': actSoothe(v); if(v) note('hum field active','n'); break;
    case 'beam': actBeam(v); if(v) note('irradiation started','n'); else note('beam off','n'); break;
    case 'rekindle': actRekindle(v); break;

}

const held={};
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT') return;
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  const map={f:'feed',p:'play',h:'soothe',c:'purge',l:'beam',r:'rest',b:'rekindle',m:'mute'};
  const a=map[k]; if(!a) return; e.preventDefault();
  if(a==='mute'){ toggleSound(); return; }

  else actFn(a);
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase(), map={h:'soothe',l:'beam',b:'rekindle'};
  const a=map[k]; if(a){ held[a]=0; padEls[a].el.classList.remove('is-on'); actFn(a,false); }
});

};

  const n=S.needs;

  document.getElementById('rVit').parentElement.style.setProperty('--p',S.vitality+'%');
  const st=STAGES[S.stage];
  const next=st.xp||S.xp;
  document.getElementById('rXp').textContent=Math.round(S.xp);
  document.getElementById('rXpNext').textContent=S.stage<3?('/'+st.xp):'(max)';
  document.getElementById('rRad').textContent=Math.round(n.lumen*(0.4+md)*9.4);
  document.getElementById('rMood').textContent=dis.toUpperCase();
  document.getElementById('mStage').textContent=st.tag;
  document.getElementById('pName').textContent=S.name||'···';
  document.getElementById('pSub').textContent=st.name+' · bonded '+(S.bond<1?'not yet':Math.round(S.bond)+'%');
  document.getElementById('mAge').textContent=awayStr((Date.now()-S.born)/1000);
  const d=new Date();
  document.getElementById('mClock').textContent=String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0');
  /* bond ring */
  const C=169.6, b=clamp(S.bond,0,100);
  const arc=document.getElementById('bondArc');
  arc.style.strokeDashoffset=C-C*b/100;
  arc.setAttribute('stroke', b>70?'#5ff2c0':b>35?'#4bd6ff':b>12?'#ffb648':'#ff5a72');
  document.getElementById('bondVal').textContent=Math.round(b);
  document.getElementById('bondTag').textContent=b>84?'devoted':b>60?'attached':b>34?'warming':b>12?'cautious':'stranger';
  document.getElementById('bondNote').textContent=
    b>84?'it rotates toward your hand before you move.':b>60?'it has learned your rhythm.':b>34?'it tolerates — then enjoys — your presence.':b>12?'wary. keep the chamber steady.':'no bond yet — it does not know your hand.';
  /* ribbon */
  const rb=document.getElementById('ribbon'), r=RIBBON[dis]||RIBBON.content;
  rb.dataset.tone=r[1]; rb.querySelector('span').textContent=r[0];
  /* stats */
  document.getElementById('sFeeds').textContent=S.counts.feed;
  document.getElementById('sPlays').textContent=S.counts.play;
  document.getElementById('sPurges').textContent=S.counts.purge;
  document.getElementById('sFugues').textContent=S.counts.fugue;
  /* advisories */
  const al=[];
  if(S.fugue) al.push(['crit','fugue · hold rekindle']);
  NEEDS.forEach(k=>{ if(n[k]<18) al.push(['crit',NEED_META[k].label.toLowerCase()+' critical']);
                     else if(n[k]<34) al.push(['',NEED_META[k].label.toLowerCase()+' low']); });
  if(S.vitality<40 && !S.fugue) al.push(['crit','vitality failing']);
  else if(S.vitality>92 && md>.8) al.push(['good','thriving']);
  if(n.lumen>93 && irradiating) al.push(['crit','over-exposure']);
  if(S.stage<3){
    const need=STAGES[S.stage].xp-S.xp, bn=STAGES[S.stage].bond-S.bond;
    if(need<60 && bn>0) al.push(['','bond gate: +'+Math.ceil(bn)]);
    else if(need<60) al.push(['good','metamorphosis imminent']);
  }
  if(!al.length) al.push(['good','all systems nominal']);
  document.getElementById('alerts').innerHTML=al.slice(0,5).map(([c,t])=>`<div class="alert ${c}">${t}</div>`).join('');
  /* hold bars */
  padEls.beam.bar.style.width=(beam*100)+'%';
  padEls.soothe.bar.style.width=(soothing?Math.min(100,n.rest):0)+'%';
  padEls.rekindle.bar.style.width=S.rekindle+'%';
  padEls.feed.el.style.opacity=feedCool>0?.55:1;
  padEls.play.el.style.opacity=(playCool>0||lure)?.55:1;
  padEls.purge.el.style.opacity=waste.length?1:.5;
  /* caption */
  if(dis!==capKey){ capKey=dis; capIdx=Math.floor(Math.random()*3); setCaption(); }
}

  const el=document.getElementById('caption'), arr=CAPTIONS[capKey]||CAPTIONS.content;

  setTimeout(()=>{ el.textContent=arr[capIdx%arr.length]; el.classList.remove('out'); },260);
}

let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000); last=now;
  const t=now/1000;
  simulate(dt); draw(t,dt); drawScope(t,dt); hud(dt);
  capT-=dt;
  if(capT<=0){ capT=rnd(6,11); if(!S.fugue) { capIdx++; setCaption(); } }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

/* ==================================================================
   INTAKE (first run)
   ================================================================== */
const NAMES=['VESPER','OOLLE','MYRRH','PIP','SABLÉ','QUILL','NIMH','AUREL','TOHU','WREN','IZZI','CALX'];
(function boot(){
  if(S.name){
    renderLog(); syncPad();
    note('containment resumed · '+S.name,'big');
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return;
  }
  const sug=document.getElementById('sugg'), inp=document.getElementById('nameIn');
  const picks=[...NAMES].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,5);
  picks.forEach(n=>{ const b=document.createElement('button'); b.textContent=n; b.onclick=()=>{inp.value=n;inp.focus();}; sug.appendChild(b); });
  inp.value=picks[0];
  const el=document.getElementById('intake'); el.hidden=false;
  const go=()=>{
    const v=(inp.value||'').trim().toUpperCase().slice(0,14)||picks[0];
    S.name=v; S.born=Date.now(); S.lastSeen=Date.now();
    el.hidden=true; aInit(); save(); syncPad();
    note(`specimen designated “${v}” · cultivation begun`,'big');
    chord([440,554,659,880],.8); flash('rgba(95,242,192,.4)');
    burst(W/2,H/2,60,170,2);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };
  document.getElementById('beginBtn').onclick=go;
  inp.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') go(); });
  setTimeout(()=>inp.focus(),260);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
